Shanghai Special District Court Search Warrant No.
2417 issued by Judge Feng at the request of the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau in respect of the Nan Jang Book Store
(南強書局), No. Y. 1139 Kong Yih Fang (公益坊),
North Szechuen Road, where it was suspected that certain com-
munist publications entitled "Dzo Wei Vung Di Bah Kaung,"
(社會問題大綱), were being housed, was executed at 3 p.m.
May 16, 1934 by members of the Special Branch accompanied
by detectives from Hongkew Station and a representative of
the Bureau of Public Safety.
Lung Ts Oen (陳子安), a Cantonese, the manager of the
bookstore was interviewed and he volunteered the information
that in December 1932 copies of the publications specified
above were forwarded to the Ministry of Education, Nanking,
for scrutiny and since they were not approved for sale all
remaining copies were destroyed.
The warrant in question is therefore returned herewith
for purposes of cancellation.

Memorandum on Pok Sing (北新) Bookstore 524 Foochow Road

For the past two or three years, the respon-
sible authorities have conducted a campaign against
bookstores which amongst their other wares have had for
sale books of a reactionary and communist nature. The
majority of these bookstores are situated in Foochow
Road and one of the chief offenders has been the Pok
Sing (北新) Bookstore No.524 Foochow Road, which has
its printing office at No.280 Tsepoo Road. Numerous
raids have been conducted on the said bookstore, re-
sulting in the seizure on various occasions of books
banned from publication by the Nationalist Government.

On January 19, 1931 the Pok Sing (北新) Book-
store was again raided by the S.M.P. on the authority
of a warrant issued at the instance of the Soong-Wu
Military Authorities and 65 books of a reactionary na-
ture seized. On March 4 of the same year, the shop in
question was sealed in accordance with the instructions
contained in Court Order No.33, which was also issued
at the request of the Soong-Wu Authorities. On April
20, 1931 the Shanghai Special District Court issued a
summons for Zee Yoong Ching (徐華慶), manager of the
Pok Sing Bookstore, to appear in Court, and after inter-
rogation by the Judge he was released on $500 security.
On July 3, 1931 Zee Yoong Ching (徐華慶) was again
summoned to appear before the Shanghai Special District
Court and was sentenced to serve one year's imprisonment.

On April 22, 1933 an appeal by Zee Yoong Ching
against his sentence was heard in the 2nd Branch of the
Kiangsu High Court, the Judge being assisted by six Kuo-
mintang members forming a jury. Both Judge and jury
agreed that appellant was guilty, judgment however being
remanded until April 27, 1933.

关于福州路524号北新（Pok Sing）书店的备忘录

在过去两三年里，主管当局开展了一场针对书店的运动，这些书店除其他商品外，还出售具有反动和共产主义性质的书籍。这些书店大多位于福州路，其中主要的违规者之一是福州路524号的北新（Pok Sing）书店，其印刷厂位于乍浦路280号。对该书店进行了多次突击搜查，导致在不同场合查获了被国民政府禁止出版的书籍。

1931年1月19日，北新（Pok Sing）书店再次被上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）突袭，此次行动依据的是应宋吴军事当局请求签发的搜查令，并查获了65本具有反动性质的书籍。同年3月4日，根据同样应宋吴当局请求签发的第33号法院命令中的指示，该店被封存。1931年4月20日，上海特区地方法院传唤北新书店经理徐華慶（Zee Yoong Ching）出庭，经法官讯问后，他以500美元保释金获释。1931年7月3日，徐華慶（Zee Yoong Ching）再次被传唤至上海特区地方法院出庭，并被判处一年监禁。

1933年4月22日，江苏高等法院第二分院审理了徐華慶对其判决提出的上诉，由六名国民党成员组成的陪审团协助法官审理。法官和陪审团均认定上诉人有罪，但判决推迟至1933年4月27日。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SUNDAY, APRIL 23, 1933

CHINESE TRIED BY
LOCAL JURY
Alleged Communist Is
Given Re-hearing;
No Verdict

The first case to be heard by
a jury in a Chinese court in the
International Settlement was held
yesterday in the Second Branch of
the Kiangsu High Court when six
Kuomintang members composed a
jury to hear the appeal of Hsu
Yung-ching, manager of the Foo
Sing Bookstore, of Foochow
Road, against a sentence of one
year's imprisonment for taking
part in communist activities.

The Chinese judicial system
does not provide for trials by jury
except in special communist cases.
The judge in the present case, it
was stated, asked the local Kuo-
mintang to select a jury to hear
the appeal. Twenty-four Kuomin-
tang members were appointed to
serve on the jury, but only six
were empanelled yesterday.

Appellant was sentenced by the
court in 1931, and subsequently
lodged an appeal with the Nanking
Supreme Court and the case was
referred back to the court here
for re-trial.

The Municipal police did not
take part in the proceedings as
the preliminary inquiries were
conducted by the procurator of
the court.

The jury deliberated for 15 min-
utes without reaching a verdict
and judgment was reserved in the
case.

Reg. Please put up file
re case.

APR. 24 1933

《字林西报》，1933年4月23日，星期日

中国人由
本地陪审团审判
涉嫌共产党人
获得重审；
未作出裁决

国际租界内中国法院由陪审团审理的首起案件昨日在江苏高等法院第二分院举行，当时由六名国民党成员组成陪审团，审理福州路福兴书店（原文为Foo Sing，疑为北新之误或另一家店，此处依原文译作福兴，但结合上下文应指同一案件当事人）经理徐永庆（Hsu Yung-ching）因参与共产党活动而被判处一年监禁的上诉案。

除特殊的共产党案件外，中国司法制度不提供陪审团审判。据称，本案法官要求当地国民党选派一个陪审团来审理上诉案。二十四名国民党成员被任命为陪审员，但昨日只有六人入席。

上诉人于1931年被法院判刑，随后向南京最高法院提出上诉，该案被发回本院重审。

市政警察未参与诉讼程序，因为初步调查由法院检察官进行。

陪审团审议了15分钟，未能达成裁决，本案判决保留。

登记。请归档有关此案的卷宗。

1933年4月24日

Mr. Kin S Kun appeared for the Police.

Mr. Kun re-outlined the case against the accused.

C.D. . 195 :- At 5.30.P.M. on the 19.1.31 the accused was arrested , when we were in company with the representatives of the Public Safety Bureau. 196 books were seized from No. 518 Foochow Road, 96 books were seized from No. 524 Foochow Road and 66 books were seized from No. 529 Foochow Road.

Accused :- The books were seized in my shops. My counsels will say what I have to say.

Mr. Wong :- Although the books were on sale in the accused's shops, he was not the editor or the publisher. In Chinese Law one cannot be held responsible for another one's act. The publisher and editor are the responsible persons, so the accused cannot be held responsible. All the books sold in the accused's shops were approved of by the Government. It is up to the Government to consider if the books are of re-actionary nature and not the Local Kuomintang.

Other counsel for accused summed up.

Mr. Kum :- The Police only assisted the Public Safety Bureau in raiding the shops and arresting the accused. It is up to this Court to consider if the books are of re-actionary nature. The Police consider the accused was aiding and abetting when selling the books to the public, so he can be held responsible, although he is not the publisher and editor.

Accused :- I have been a member of the Kuomintang for three years.

Kun 先生重新概述了对被告的指控。

C.D. . 195 :- 1931年1月19日下午5点30分，当我们与公安局代表在一起时，被告被捕。从福州路518号查获196本书，从福州路524号查获96本书，从福州路529号查获66本书。

被告：书籍是在我的店里被查获的。我的律师会陈述我要说的话。

Wong 先生：虽然书籍在被告的店里出售，但他不是编辑或出版商。在中国法律中，一个人不能为另一个人的行为负责。出版商和编辑是责任人，因此被告不应承担责任。被告店里出售的所有书籍都经过政府批准。应由政府考虑书籍是否具有反动性质，而不是由地方国民党考虑。

被告的另一位律师总结陈词。

Kum 先生：警方仅协助公安局突袭店铺并逮捕被告。由本庭考虑书籍是否具有反动性质。警方认为被告在向公众出售书籍时起到了教唆和协助作用，因此他应承担责任，尽管他不是出版商和编辑。

被告：我加入国民党已有三年。

Proceedings Mr. Wong Vah Zang appeared for the 2nd and 3rd accused.
C.D.C. 195 :- Att the witnesses summoned are in Court ex-
cept Tai Foh Nien who was not located and Lee Tse Yuen and Wong Sing
Sing who have failed to appear after being summoned.
1st witness :- I am the manager of the Chuen Chuug Book
Store. There is another manager taking charge of the wholesale
department. Fong Tang Liang is the General Manager of the Store and
is now in Nanking. I am taking responsibility of the entire firm.
Also I am responsible for the sale of books and the General Manager
is not responsible for that. He takes charge of all the accounts of
the store and does not come to the store very often.

2nd witness :- I was the manager of the Poh Sing Book Store.
I had been holding that position since the death of the late manager
named Wong Zoong Sing (September last year) up to the sealing of the
store. I was the person taking charge of the sales department and
the 3rd witness was my assistant. I took responsibility in every
respect and even criminal liability and not the 3rd witness.

3rd witness :- I am the partner of the Poh Sung Book Store.
I was the assistant to the 2nd witness as he is young. He used to
consult with me in any affair. I was also responsible for whatever
he did. He spoke to me about books to be place on sale.

Witness Zau Soh Wei :- I am the proprietor of the Chung Ming
Loh Yuen Restaurant. The downstairs of my shop was rented to the
Combined Sales Department of the Loh Chuen, Tsung Siang, Kwen Lung
and Nan Jang Books Stores. Wong Sing King came to rent the premises.
Here is the book (handed to Court). The house was rented during Nov-
ember of the 18th year of the Chinese Republic. The book is not a
forgery and was not made out after the seal of the store. I am the
chief tenant of the premises.

Witness Lee Sao Foong :- I am the editor of the Poh Sung Book Store. I am representing Tsai Suh Loh who is not in Shanghai. I am taking charge of editing work and not sales. We do not reponsible for books sold by us but published by others.
Detective Wong Ping of the Public Safety Bureau :- I received information from an informer that the book stores situated along Foochow Road are selling books of a reactionary nature and that such books were obtained from the Poh Sing, Chuen Chung, Kiang Nan and the Combined Sales Department of the Loh Chung, Tsung Ziang, Kwen Lung and Nan Jang Book Stores. Here are the 14 books and one voucher (produced) The other 4 vouchers were handed over to the Police Advocate Mr Kum by our Advocate Tseu Gee Voong to be forwarded to the foreign detective of the Louza Station. After obtaining these books I reported the matter to our Headquarters who applied to this Court for the issuance of the search warrants and I accompanied by the detective of the Louza Station raided the Poh Sing and Loh Chung Book Stores and numerous kinds of books of reactionary nature were found. We have now forwarded a list of seized books to the Police to be submitted to this Court. We arrested Manager Yue Ziang Sung of the Wha Tung Book Store and he was sentenced to one year's imprisonment. With regard to the Chuen Chung and Kiang Nan Book Stores, they are situated in the near vicinity of the Poh Sing and Loh Chuen Book stores, but they are in the Central Station's District. When I and the Louza detectives raided the latter, the former received information and had hidden all reactionary books away. Therefore when we went there with the Central detectives, we saw a number of empty cabinets and no reactionary books could be found. The manager of the above 4 stores were summoned but failed to appear. Consequently our headquarters applied to this Court for the seal of the stores. These stores were sealed up between 2 and 5 p.m. I did not see myself the Kiang Nan and Chuen Chung Book Stores hiding the reactionary books away as I was carrying out the raids at the Poh Sing and Loh Chung Book stores. When we raided the Kiang Nan, Chuen Chung Stores, we saw many empty

公安局侦探 Wong Ping：我从线人处获悉，福州路沿线的书局正在出售具有反动性质的书籍，这些书籍来源于宝兴、全中、江南书局，以及罗春、宗祥、昆隆和南江书局的联合销售部。这里有14本书和一张凭证（出示）。另外四张凭证已由我们的律师 Tseu Gee Voong 移交给警务督察官 Kum 先生，以便转交老闸捕房的外国侦探。获得这些书籍后，我向总局报告此事，总局向本庭申请搜查令，随后我与老闸捕房的侦探一起突击搜查了宝兴和罗春书局，发现了大量具有反动性质的书籍。我们现在已将查获书籍清单移送警务处，以便提交本庭。我们逮捕了华通书局经理 Yue Ziang Sung，他被判处一年监禁。至于全中和江南书局，它们位于宝兴和罗春书局附近，但属于中央捕房辖区。当我和老闸捕房的侦探搜查后者时，前者收到消息并将所有反动书籍藏匿。因此，当我们与中央捕房侦探前往那里时，只看到许多空柜子，未发现反动书籍。上述四家书局的经理均被传唤但未到庭。因此，我们总局向本庭申请查封这些店铺。这些店铺在下午2点至5点之间被封存。我并未亲眼目睹江南和全中书局藏匿反动书籍，因为我当时正在对宝兴和罗春书局进行突击搜查。当我们搜查江南、全中书局时，我们看到许多空

Extract of proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court for Friday. May 15th. 1931.
Station No. 2490.C. Soong, Kao & Yih.
Register No. 5/20323. Station Louza. Procurator Wong. Judge Mr.

Sheet No.10.

Proceedings. Mr. Kum appeared for the Police.
C.D.C.195:- The Police received certain incriminating evidence against Wong Sing Ming and Dan Foh Nyien but could not arrest them as they were unable to obtain any trace of them.
Procurator Wong:- In the first instance 7 accused were charged and subsequently another. The last charged has admitted in Court that he was the manager of the "Loh Kyuin" book store. All the accused are managers at the four book stores and sold Communistic literature. An investigation was made by the local Chinese Garrison commander and books were bought before the charge was laid against them and search warrants applied for from this Court. Over 200 hundred books were found in the "Poh Sing" and "Loh Kyuin" stores but nothing in the "Zeu Tscong" and Kiang Nan stores. The latter two establishments however, are situated in different districts and received warning in time to dispose of their incriminating stock. The books admittedly are not published by them but they are the agents for sale and are charged on the evidence contained in books found during the search.
Lee Sao Foong, Witness:- I am the general manager of the "Poh Sing" book store on Tsepo Road and we have seven branches. Zee Yoong Ching is the sales manager at the Foochow Road branch and Loh Mi Zu is the accountant. A search was made on the 19th. of January but I do not know how many books of the type under enquiry were found. We sell 5000 or 6000 kinds of books published by other concerns and about 500 of our own. I was not present at the time of the search. I cannot remember which published a book entitled "Marx's Principles". A list was prepared giving the names of the various publishers and handed into Court. A meeting was convened on the 24th. February at the "Ts Doong Boo" (District Government) at which all publishers were present and a list of prohibited books was given to each. The books seized at my store are not shown thereon.
Zee Yoong Ching, Witness:- I am a salesman at the "Poh Sing" store. The books were sold by us on behalf of other publishing concerns which are still carrying on business. The list was found on the 19th. of

第10页。

庭审记录。律师 Kum 代表警方出庭。
C.D.C.195:- 警方掌握了针对 Wong Sing Ming 和 Dan Foh Nyien 的一些不利证据，但因无法找到他们的踪迹而未能逮捕他们。
检察官 Wong：最初起诉了7名被告，随后又增加了一名。最后一名被告在庭上承认他是“罗群”（Loh Kyuin）书局的经理。所有被告均为这四家书局的经理，并销售共产主义文献。在当地中国驻军司令进行调查并在对他们提出指控之前购买了书籍，并向本庭申请了搜查令。在“宝兴”和“罗群”书局发现了两百多本书，但在“泽众”（Zeu Tscong）和江南书局未发现任何书籍。然而，后两家机构位于不同辖区，并及时收到警告以处理掉其罪证库存。诚然，这些书籍并非由他们出版，但他们是销售代理，并根据搜查中发现的书籍所含证据被起诉。
证人 Lee Sao Foong：我是芝罘路（Tsepo Road）“宝兴”书局的总经理，我们有七家分店。Zee Yoong Ching 是福州路分店的销售经理，Loh Mi Zu 是会计。一月十九日进行了搜查，但我不知道发现了多少本受查类型的书籍。我们销售五千或六千种由其他机构出版的书籍，以及约五百种我们自己的书籍。搜查时我不在场。我不记得是谁出版了一本名为《马克思主义原理》的书。已编制了一份列出各出版商名字的清单并提交法庭。二月二十四日在“区公署”（Ts Doong Boo）召开了一次会议，所有出版商均出席，并向每人分发了一份禁书清单。在我店被查扣的书籍并未列在其中。
证人 Zee Yoong Ching：我是“宝兴”书局的销售员。这些书籍是由我们代表其他仍在营业的出版机构销售的。该清单是由驻军司令的代表于一月十九日发现的。

这些书籍是很早以前出版的，我不知道它们的销售已被禁止。

证人 Lok Mi Zu：我受雇为福州路分店的出纳，在一月十九日代替 Zee Yoong Ching 工作。被查扣的书籍是去年九月由一名叫 Wong Tshien Sung 的人带到我们店里的。

Fong Tang Liang：确实，我们销售了所列出的书籍。
证人 Feng Sur Tsu：我是“群青”书局的销售经理。我们保留自己出版物的目录。

证人 Tsang Wei：我是“罗群”书局的经理，Wong Sing Ming 是“南强”书局的经理。搜查时我不在场。（此处向证人递交一本书供查验）。我不知道这是否是被查扣的书籍之一。我只负责管理我们自己出版物的销售。

Wong Ping：我这里有一份在执行搜查前所购书籍的详情（证人随即向法庭朗读书名等）。

other part of the house to 3 book stores, which were all sealed, and
now the seals of 2 of the stores have been removed , and one of them
named "Kong Nyeu" is still sealed. The people of this store have abs-
conded. The witness in the Court, is not concerned in the case, and
wishes to make an application to have the seals removed so that he
can sub-let the place to other people.

Judge to Mr. Ts:- Will the witness be responsible to keep the
property seized in good order, if so then the seals of the place can
be removed.

Mr. Ts in answer to Judge:- My client will be responsible to put
the property aside and keep it in good order.

Wit. Woo Tsingx Koong:- There is not much property in the house.

Judge to Wit.:- You are to make out a list of the property
seized, sign it, and send it to this Court.

Decision. Landlord Woo Tsing Kong is held responsible to look after the
property seized from the Kiang Nan Book Store pending further
disposal.

W.H.B.

庭审记录。K.S. Kum 先生代表警方出庭。
Ts Fong 先生代表证人出庭。

证人 Woo Tsing Koong（房东）：我是“正始书局”的代表。我不认识一个叫 Wong Sing Ming 的人。我们将房屋的一部分转租给了“宗赛书局”（Tsoong Sai Book Store），现在他们不想继续租赁该处所。

Ts Fong 先生向法官陈述：“宗赛书局”将房屋的另一部分转租给了三家书店，这些书店均已被查封，目前其中两家书店的封条已被移除，另一家名为“公纽”（Kong Nyeu，音译）的书店仍被封存。该店人员已潜逃。出庭证人与本案无关，希望申请移除封条，以便将该处所转租给他人。

法官问 Ts 先生：如果证人负责妥善保管被扣押的财产，是否可以移除该处的封条？

Ts 先生回答法官：我的委托人将负责把财产另行存放并妥善保管。

证人 Woo Tsingx Koong：屋内财产不多。

法官对证人说：你需要列出被扣押财产的清单，签字后送交本庭。

裁决。房东 Woo Tsing Kong 须负责看管从江南书局扣押的财产，以待进一步处理。

W.H.B.

re. ' Wong Loo Sung ' is the manager and the assistant manager is

Witness: Zee Yoong Ching:- I did not know the the sale of these
books was against the Law. I did not know that these books were
in any way communistic.
Witness: Loh Mi Zu:- I am the accountant of the store only &
did not know the nature of the books. I only have the accounts to keep
and have nothing to do with the sales.
Witness: Fong Teng Liang:- I am a share holder in the book
store. In the shop there were no books of Reactionary Literature
found.. Three books were sent to the shop as samples to be looked
through. One of each Publication.
Wit: Tong Sheu Tse:- The three books sent to the shop as samples
were seized by the police.
( Summing up. )

Kim 先生：向法庭概述案情。
C.D.J.195：本庭已签发逮捕“Wong Sing Ming”和“Dai Foo Nyi”两人的拘票，但警方未能找到他们。我听说“Wong”此人去了广州。

证人：Lee Sao Tuck：我是该店的总经理，也是股东。我现在知道警方在店内查获了100本此类书籍，但我并不知道它们是涉及“Wong Loo Sung”的案件。“Wong Loo Sung”是经理，副经理是“Zee Yoong Ching”。

证人：Zee Yoong Ching：我不知道销售这些书籍是违法的。我不知道这些书籍有任何共产主义性质。

证人：Loh Mi Zu：我只是店里的会计，不知道书籍的性质。我只负责记账，与销售无关。

证人：Fong Teng Liang：我是书店的股东。店内未发现反动文学书籍。有三本书作为样书寄到店里供翻阅。每种出版物各一本。

还押候判，直至1931年7月3日上午9时。

W.R.Parker.

Proceedings. Mr. Lea appeared for the Police.
Mr. Lea :- Re-outlined the case.
Accused in answer to Judge :- I am the owner and manager of the book store. The capital is $10,000.00 and the shop has been opened for two years. All the books were placed in the shop for sale . I did not know that they were communists books. I did not know that it was forbidden to sell them. I look after the accounts. We did not receive any orders from the Authorities that the books could not be sold, otherwise we would never have sold them. The Shanghai "Kuomin-tang" did not give us any notice not to sell them. We have no time to look at the contents of the books. They are not our own printed books.

September 15, 1931.

Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Gentlemen,

With reference to a case of Offence against State versus Soo Ta Hsin (李志雲) et al, despite various hearings having been heard, the following defendants viz:- Wang Sing Ming (王心民), Dai Foh Hien (戴福年) and Tsang Wei (張偉) have failed and still fail to appear to answer the charge against them. Consequently a decision was given to the effect that the proceedings against these be suspended and a circular order of arrest be issued forthwith. I have to request you to give instructions to your subordinates with a view to effecting their arrest and bringing them to justice.

Extract of proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court for Friday, May 1st.
Station No. 2490.C.

Register No. 5/20323. Station LOUZA. Procurator WONG. Judge Mr.

Sheet No. 10.

Proceedings.
Mr. Kuz appeared for Police.

C. .C.195:- The Police received certain incriminating evidence against Jong Sing Ling and Dan Poh Kylin but could not arrest them as they were unable to obtain any trace of them.

Procurator Wong:- In the first instance 7 accused were charged and subsequently another. The last charged has admitted in Court that he was the manager of the "Loh Kyuin" book store. All the accused are managers at the four book stores and sold Communistic literature. An investigation was made by the local Chinese Garrison commander and books were bought before the charge was laid against them and search warrants applied for from this Court. Over 200 hundred books were found in the "Poh Sing" and Loh Kyuin stores but nothing in the "Zeu Tsoong" and Kiang Nan stores. The latter two establishments however, are situated in different districts and receive warning in time to dispose of the incriminating stock. The books admittedly are not published by them but they are the agents for sale and were charged on the evidence contained in books found during the search.

Lee Soo Foong, Witness:- I am the general manager of the "Poh Sing" book store on Tsapoo Road and we have seven branches. Zee Yoong Ching is the sales manager at the Foochow Road branch and Loh Hi Zu is the accountant. A search was made on the 19th. of January 1931. but I do not know how many books of the type under enquiry were found. We sell 5000 or 6000 kinds of books published by other concerns and about 500 of our own. I was not present at the time of the search. I cannot remember who published a book entitled "Marx's Principles". A list was prepared giving the names of the various publishers and handed into Court. A meeting was convened on the 24th. February at the "Ta Doong Boo" (District Government) at which all publishers were present and a list of prohibited books was given to each. The books seized at my store are not shown thereon.

Zee Yoong Ching, Witness:- I am a salesman at the "Poh Sing" store. The books were sold by us on behalf of other publishing concerns which

诉讼程序。
Kuz 先生代表警方出庭。

C. .C.195:- 警方掌握了针对 Jong Sing Ling（音译）和 Dan Poh Kylin（音译）的某些定罪证据，但无法逮捕他们，因为找不到他们的踪迹。

检察官 Wong:- 最初有7名被告被起诉，随后又增加了一名。最后被起诉者在法庭上承认他是“乐群”书店的经理。所有被告均为这四家书店的经理，并出售共产主义文献。当地中国驻军指挥官进行了调查，在对其提出指控并向本法院申请搜查令之前购买了书籍。在“北新”和“乐群”书店发现了200多本书籍，但在“群众”和江南书店未发现任何书籍。然而，后两家机构位于不同辖区，并及时收到警告以处理掉定罪的库存。据承认，这些书籍并非由他们出版，但他们是销售代理，并根据搜查期间发现的书籍中所含证据被起诉。

证人 Lee Soo Foong（音译）:- 我是乍浦路“北新”书店的总经理，我们有七家分店。Zee Yoong Ching（音译）是福州路分店的销售经理，Loh Hi Zu（音译）是会计师。搜查是在1931年1月19日进行的。但我不知道发现了多少本受查问类型的书籍。我们出售其他公司出版的5000或6000种书籍，以及约500种我们自己的出版物。搜查时我不在场。我不记得是谁出版了一本名为《马克思主义原理》的书。已编制了一份列出各出版商名单的清单并提交法院。2月24日在“大东书局”（区政府）召开了一次会议，所有出版商均出席，并向每人提供了一份禁书清单。在我店查获的书籍并未列在其中。

证人 Zee Yoong Ching（音译）:- 我是“北新”书店的店员。这些书籍是由我们代表其他出版公司销售的，这些

Loh Li Lu, Witness:- I am employed as a shroff at the Foochow Road store and was acting as a substitute for Zee Young Ching on the 19th. January. The books seized were brought to our shop in September of last year by a man named Wong Tahien Sung.

Wong Ping, rep of the Garrison Commander:- Nothing was found in the last witnesses store but we had bought Communistic books there before acting on the warrant.
Fong Tang Liang:- It is true that we sold the books enumerated.

Wong Ping:- I have here the details of the books bought before search was made (Witness then read out the titles, etc. to the Court).

Subject (in full) Kyuin Tsong (群眾) and Poh Sing (北新)
Bookstores, Nos. 95 and 524 Foochow Road.

Made by I. Ross Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.D.I.

With reference to the endorsement of the C.C. Special
Branch on the attached report dated April 24 1931, I have to
state that the premises in question were unsealed by the
Judicial Police in co-operation of the Police of Louza Station.

The Kyuin Tsong Bookstore, No 95 Foochow Road, was
searched, on the authority of warrants issued, in each case,
at the instance of the Soongwu Military Headquarters, for
inflammatory literature on January 14 and 19, 1931. Nothing,
however, of an incriminating nature was found on either occasion.
On March 4, 1931, a warrant for the arrest of the manager, Faung
Tong Liang (方棟樑), on a charge of propagating communism, and
Court order No 33 authorizing the sealing of the premises, were
issued at the request of the same authorities. At the time of
the Police visit the manager was absent and the store was duly
sealed in accordance with the instructions embodied in the
Court order. No reactionary books were seized at this address,
and as the premises were immediately sealed no opportunity was
afforded to this office to examine the content of the premises.

The Poh Sing (北新) Bookstore, No 524 Foochow Road,
was raided on the authority of a warrant issued at the instance
of the Soongwu Military Headquarters on January 19, 1931, and
some 65 books of a reactionary nature seized. Translations of
extracts from the more extreme books were subsequently made by
S.S. and are to be found in this file flagged 'A'. On or about
April 6, 1931, these books, together with a number of others,
of a similar nature, seized on the same date, (January 19) at
the Loh Kyuin (樂群) Bookstore, No 518 Foochow Road, were
ordered confiscated by the Shanghai Special District Court.

主题（全称）群众书店和北新书店，福州路95号和524号。

制作人 I. Ross 转呈人 Henry Robertson 刑事侦缉总探长。

关于附件中1931年4月24日报告上刑事特别处处长的批注，我必须声明，涉案场所已由司法警察在与老闸捕房警务人员的合作下解封。

福州路95号群众书店，根据每次应淞沪警备司令部之请签发的搜查令，于1931年1月14日和19日因煽动性文献受到搜查。然而，两次均未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。
1931年3月4日，应同一当局请求，签发了以传播共产主义罪名逮捕经理 Faung Tong Liang (方棟樑) 的逮捕令，以及授权查封该场所的第33号法院命令。警方造访时经理不在，店铺已按照法院命令中的指示 duly 查封。在该地址未查获反动书籍，由于场所立即被封，本部门没有机会检查场所内的内容。

福州路524号北新书店，根据1931年1月19日应淞沪警备司令部之请签发的搜查令遭到突击搜查，查获约65本反动性质的书籍。随后由特别处对一些较为极端的书籍摘录进行了翻译，见本档案中标记为‘A’的部分。1931年4月6日左右，上海特区地方法院下令没收这些书籍，以及在相同日期（1月19日）于福州路518号乐群书店查获的其他类似性质的书籍。

Date April 24, 1931.

Subject (in full) Kyuin Tsong (群衆 ) and Poh Sing (北新 ) Bookstores Nos 95
and 524 Foochow Road, unsealed.

Made by D. I. Ross Forwarded by [手写签名：Henry Robertson] C. O. I.

The Kyuin Tsong and Poh Sing Bookstores Nos. 95 and
524 Foochow Road, which were sealed on March 4, 1931, in
accordance with the instructions contained in Court order No. 33,
issued at the instance of the Soongwu Military Headquarters,
charging these stores with being in possession of reactionary
books for the purpose of propagating communism, were unsealed
during the afternoon of April 23.

It is reported that the removal of the seals
was effected through the mediation of the Propaganda Department
of Central Kuomintang Headquarters and the furnishing,
on April 20, of $500 shop security to the Special District
Court by the respective proprietors of the bookstores.

[手写签名：O.B. Ray]
D. I.
O.C. Special Branch.

A paragraph referring to the above
will be included in the Daily Report.

By whom were the premises
unsealed. It seems from the case
in which the Sp. Br. should have been
given an opportunity to examine the books
of the stores and the contents of the premises
what became of the reactionary books which
the stores were alleged to be in possession of.

位于福州路95号和524号的群众书店和北新书店，曾根据淞沪警备司令部提出的指控，即这些书店持有旨在宣传共产主义的反动书籍，并依据第33号法院命令的指示，于1931年3月4日被查封，现于4月23日下午启封。

C.D.C. 195 : - All the witnesses summoned are in Court except Tai Foh Nien who was not located and Lee Tse Yuen and Wong Sing Sing who have failed to appear after being summoned.

1st witness : -, I am the manager of the Chuen Chung Book Store. There is another manager taking charge of the wholesale department. Fong Tang Liang is the General Manager of the Store and is now in Nanking. I am taking responsibility of the entire firm. Also I am responsible for the sale of books and the General Manager is not responsible for that. He takes charge of all the accounts of the store and does not come to the store very often.

2nd witness : - I was the manager of the Poh Sing Book Store. I had been holding that position since the death of the late manager named Wong Zoong Sing (September last year) up to the sealing of the store. I was the person taking charge of the sales department and the third witness was my assistant. I took responsibility in every respect and even criminal liability and not the 3rd witness.

3rd witness : - I am the partner of the Poh Sung Book Store. I was the assistant to the 2nd witness as he is young. He used to consult with me in any affair. I was also responsible for whatever he did. He spoke to me about books to be placed on sale.

Here is the book (handed to Court). The house was rented during November of the 18th year of the Chinese Republic. The book is not a forgery and was not made out after the seal of the store. I am the chief tenant of the premises.

Detective Wong Ping of the Public Safety Bureau : - I received information from an informer that the book stores situated along Foochow Road are selling books of a reactionary nature and that such books were obtained from the Poh Sing, Chuen Chung, Kiang Man and the Combined Sales Department of the Loh Chung, Tsung Ziang, Kwen Lung and

诉讼程序 Mr. Wong Vah Zang 代表第二和第三被告出庭。

C.D.C. 195 ：- 所有被传唤的证人均已到庭，除 Tai Foh Nien 未被找到，以及 Lee Tse Yuen 和 Wong Sing Sing 在被传唤后未能出庭外。

第一证人：- 我是全中书局的经理。还有另一位经理负责批发部。Fong Tang Liang 是书店的总经理，目前在南京。我对整个商号负责。我也负责图书销售，总经理对此不负责。他负责书店的所有账目，不常来书店。

第二证人：- 我是北新书店的经理。自前任经理 Wong Zoong Sing （去年九月）去世至书店被封期间，我一直担任该职。我是负责销售部的人，第三证人是我的助手。我在各方面承担责任，包括刑事责任，而非第三证人。

第三证人：- 我是北新书店的合伙人。我是第二证人的助手，因为他年轻。他在任何事务上都会与我商量。我也对他所做的任何事情负责。他曾与我谈论要上架销售的书籍。

证人 Zau Soh Wei ：- 我是众明乐园酒家的业主。我店铺的楼下租给了乐群、总祥、昆龙和南强书店的联合销售部。Wong Sing Ming 来租赁该场所。这是账簿（递交法庭）。房屋是在民国十八年十一月出租的。这本账簿不是伪造的，也不是在书店被封后制作的。我是该场所的主要承租人。

证人 Lee Sao Foong ：- 我是北新书店的编辑。我代表不在上海的 Tsai Suh Loh 。我负责编辑工作，而非销售。我们不对我们销售但由他人出版的书籍负责。

公安局侦探 Wong Ping ：- 我从线人处获悉，位于福州路的书店正在销售具有反动能性质的书籍，这些书籍来自北新、全中、江南以及乐群、总祥、昆龙和

pages.en:
- 2 -

Nan Jang Book Stores. Here are the 14 books and one voucher
(produced) The other 4 vouchers were handed over to the Police
Advocate Mr. Kum by our Advocate Tseu Gee Voong to be for-
warded to the foreign detective of the Louza Station. After
obtaining these books I reported the matter to our Head-
quarters who applied to this Court for the issuance of the
search warrants and I accompanied by the detective of the
Louza Station raided the Poh Sing and Loh Chung Book Stores
and numerous kinds of books of reactionary nature were
found. We have now forwarded a list of seized books to the
Police to be submitted to this Court. We arrested Manager
Yue Ziang Sung of the Wha Tung Book Store and he was sen-
tenced to one year's imprisonment. With regard to the
Chuen Chung and Kiang Nan Book Stores, they are situated in
the near vicinity of the Poh Sing and Loh Chuen Book Stores,
but they are in the Central Station's District. When I and
the Louza detectives raided the latter, the former received
information and had hidden all reactionary books away.
Therefore when we went there with the Central detectives,
we saw a number of empty cabinets and no reactionary books
could be found. The manager of the above 4 stores were
summoned but failed to appear. Consequently our headquarters
applied to this Court for the seal of the stores. These
stores were sealed up between 2 and 5 p.m. I did not see
myself the Kiang Nan and Chuen Chung Book Stores hiding
the reactionary books away as I was carrying out the raids
at the Poh Sing and Loh Chung Book Stores. When we raided
the Kiang Nan, Chuen Chung Stores, we saw many empty cabinets
and all other books were still there but not the reactionary
ones. We read the books over roughly and it was later than
5 p.m. There were no reactionary books in the 4 stores when
they were sealed up.

2nd witness : - We made 20 to 30 percent of profit
out of the sale of books published by others. We did not
make substantial profit on the sale of the communistic books.
Every store is selling such books. There were prohibited
to sell by the Kuomintang Headquarters. We did not know they
were reactionary books. It is a usual practice of the book
stores to sell books which are published by others. I did
now know that Marks books are of a reactionary nature until
I received orders from the Kuomintang Headquarters, prohi-
biting its sale. We kept account book which will prove
that we did not make substantial profit on such books.

Decision    Fong Sur Tsu to put up $1,000.00 shop security for
appearance whenever required.

            Zee Yoong Ching and Loh Mi Zu - Each to put up $500.00
shop security (each) for appearance whenever required.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

南强书店的联合销售部。这里有14本书和一张凭证
（出示） 另外4张凭证已由我们的律师 Tseu Gee Voong 移交给
警方律师 Kum 先生，以便转交给老闸捕房的外籍侦探。在获
得这些书籍后，我向总部报告了此事，总部向本法院申请签发
搜查令，我陪同老闸捕房的侦探突袭了北新和乐群书店，
发现了多种具有反动能性质的书籍。我们现在已将查获书籍
清单 forwarded 给警方，以便提交本法院。我们逮捕了华通
书店的经理 Yue Ziang Sung ，他被判处一年监禁。关于
全中和江南书店，它们位于北新和乐群书店附近，
但它们属于中央捕房辖区。当我和老闸侦探突袭后者时，前者
收到消息并将所有反动书籍藏匿起来。
因此，当我们与中央捕房侦探前往那里时，我们看到许多空柜子，
找不到任何反动书籍。上述4家书店的经理
被传唤但未出庭。因此，我们的总部
向本法院申请查封这些书店。这些
书店在下午2点至5点之间被封存。我并未亲眼
看到江南和全中书店藏匿反动书籍，因为我当时
正在对北新和乐群书店进行突袭。当我们突袭
江南、全中书店时，我们看到许多空柜子，
其他所有书籍都还在，但反动书籍不在。我们粗略地
翻阅了书籍，当时已是下午5点以后。这4家书店
被封存时，里面没有反动书籍。

第二证人：- 我们销售他人出版的书籍可获得20%至30%的利润。
我们在销售共产主义书籍方面并未获得 substantial 利润。
每家书店都在销售此类书籍。国民党总部禁止销售。
我们不知道它们是反动书籍。书店销售他人出版的书籍
是惯例。直到我收到国民党总部禁止销售的命令后，
我才知道马克思的书籍具有反动能性质。我们保留了
账簿，这将证明我们在此类书籍上并未获得 substantial 利润。

决定    Fong Sur Tsu 需提供1,000.00美元店铺保释金，
以保证随传随到。

            Zee Yoong Ching 和 Loh Mi Zu - 每人需提供500.00美元
店铺保释金（每人），以保证随传随到。

20 - 4 - 31

Subject (in full) Bookstores at Nos 95, 513, 524 and 529 Foochow Road and 165
Shantung Road.

Made by D. I. Ross Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.M.

With reference to the Officer i/c Special Branch,
endorsement on the attached report of April 11, on the above
subject, enquiries show that the seals which were affixed to the
Kyuin Tong (群衆), Loh Kyuin (楽群) and Foh Sing (北新)
Bookstores Nos 95, 513 and 524 Foochow Road respectively, on
March 4, 1931, have not yet been removed. In connection with the
first and third named firms, it is reported that an application
has been made by the Propaganda Department of the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters to have these places unsealed.

The Kiangnan Bookstore (江南書店) which shares premises
with three other concerns at No. 165 Shantung Road, was also sealed
on March 4. This address was later unsealed on March 26, on the
application of the other tenants, and the books and property of
the Kiangnan Bookstore, resealed in an inner room in the same
building in accordance with the instructions contained in Court
Order No. 385.

Regarding the Hwa Tung (華通) Bookstore, No. 529
Foochow Road, this shop was raided on January 19, 1931, on the
authority of a warrant, issued at the request of the Soongwu
Military Headquarters, and 66 publications of a reactionary
nature seized. Yu Tsong-sun (俞祥生), the manager of the store,
was taken into custody on a charge of "Offence against Public
Order", contrary to Article 160 of the C.C.R.C. He was
subsequently released on bail in the sum of $5,000 and on
February 18, he was convicted, in his absence, to 12 months
imprisonment and 43 out of the 66 books which were seized, were
ordered to be confiscated. No application was made for the
sealing of this store.

Yu Tsong-sun is reported to be at present in Nanking.

D.C. (Cr. & Sp. Branches)
D. I.

位于山东路165号并与另外三家商号共用场所的江南书店，也于3月4日被查封。该地址后来应其他租户的申请于3月26日启封，而江南书店的书籍和财产则根据第385号法院命令中包含的指示，在同一建筑物内的内室重新封存。

关于福州路529号的华通书店，该店于1931年1月19日应淞沪警备司令部的请求，凭搜查令遭到突袭，查获66种具有反动能性质的出版物。该店经理俞祥生因涉嫌违反《中华民国刑法》第160条“妨害秩序罪”而被拘留。他随后以5,000美元保释金获释，并于2月18日缺席被判12个月监禁，查获的66本书中有43本被下令没收。未对该店提出查封申请。

据报俞祥生目前在南京。

副督察

Extract of Court proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court
for Friday, Feb.13, 1931. Judge: Messrs Soong,Doo, Yih.

Proceedings

Mr.King S Kum appeared for the Police.
Mr.Wong Yu Ling and Mr.Lee Yuin appeared for the
accused.
Mr.Kum re-outlined the case against the accused.

C.D.C.195:- At 5.30 p.m. on the 19.1.31 the accused
was arrested, when we were in company with the representatives
of the Public Safety Bureau. 196 books were seized from No.518 I
Foochow Road, 96 books were seized from No.524 Foochow Road
and 66 books were seized from No.529 Foochow Road.

Accused: The books were seized in my shops. My
counsel will say what I have to say.

Mr.Wong :- Although the books were on sale in the
accused' s shops, he was not the editor or the publisher. In
Chinese Law one cannot be held responsible for another one's
act. The publisher and editor are the responsible persons,
so the accused cannot be held responsible. All the books sold in
the accused's shops were approved of by the Government. It is
up to the Government to consider if the books are of re -
actionary nature and not the Local Kuomintang.

Other counsel for accused summed up,

Mr.Kum:- The Police only assisted the Public Safety
Bureau in raiding the shops and arresting the accused. It is up
to this Court to consider if the books are of re-actionary
nature. The Police consider the accused was aiding and abetting
when selling the books to the public, so he can be held responsib:
although he is not the publisher and editor.

Accused :- I have been a member of the Kuomintang for
three years.

Decision Remand to the 18.2.31 P.M. for Judgment.

King S Kum 先生代表警方出庭。
Wong Yu Ling 先生和 Lee Yuin 先生代表被告出庭。
Kum 先生重新概述了对被告的指控。

C.D.C.195:- 1931年1月19日下午5时30分，被告在与公共安全局代表同行时被逮捕。从福州路518号查获196本书籍，从福州路524号查获96本书籍，从福州路529号查获66本书籍。

被告：书籍是在我的店里被查获的。我的辩护律师会陈述我要说的话。

Wong 先生 :- 虽然书籍在被告的店里出售，但他并非编辑或出版商。根据中国法律，一人不对他人的行为负责。出版商和编辑是责任人，因此被告不应承担责任。被告店里出售的所有书籍均经政府批准。应由政府考量书籍是否具有反动性质，而非地方国民党部。

被告的其他辩护律师总结陈词，

Kum 先生:- 警方仅协助公共安全局搜查店铺并逮捕被告。书籍是否具有反动性质应由本庭考量。警方认为被告在向公众出售书籍时起到了教唆和协助作用，因此尽管他不是出版商和编辑，仍应承担责任。

被告 :- 我已成为国民党党员三年。

裁决 还押至1931年2月18日下午以待判决。

诉讼程序

被告回答法官问话 :- 我是华通书店的经理。

Kum 先生:- 被告被控违反《反共法》第6条。他于1931年1月19日在福州路529号持特区地方法院逮捕令被捕，罪名是持有共产主义书籍。警方会同上海公共安全局侦探逮捕了被告。

D.S.I. Cumming :- 1931年1月19日下午2时15分，宋吴军事当局代表 C.D.C. Wong Ping 请求租界警方协助在福州路529号一家书店执行逮捕令。查获大量具有共产主义性质的书籍，并逮捕了被告。一名代表在庭上要求移交被告以及查获的六十六本书籍。

证人 Wong Ping，军事当局代表:- 1931年1月8日，获悉许多书摊正在出售具有共产主义性质的书籍。派人购买了一些，店主起疑并藏匿了书籍。当店铺被搜查时，查获了许多不同种类的共产主义书籍。一名叫 Yang Chih 的人在庭上，可以证明

Wit. Yang Chih:- I am an inspector attached to the Sung
Woo Military Authorities. To look for these books, I accompanied
a raiding party on the 19.1.31. These books are all of a Communistic
nature, some of them are issued by the Communistic Party themselves.
Accused to Judge:- These books are not published by the
Wha Tung Book Co., they were not printed in the shop. These books
sell very well, so for business we stock them. These books have
not been prohibited by the Government. We do not want to work on
behalf of the Communistic Government. I deny that the books are
printed by our shop.
Mr. Chang:- These books are not printed in the shop, so
accused cannot be held responsible. Two others, Foo Shing and
Loh Ching have not been arrested, and I ask the Court to issue a
warrant for their arrest. Also I ask for this Court to try the
case.
Mr.Ching for accused:- The books are not printed in this
shop, other shops sell these books as well. Accused only keeps
them for sale. I ask that accused be allowed bail, as he can give
all addresses of publishers of the books.
Mr.Kum:- During the remand, accused can give names of the
publishers, and the police can make further enquiries.
Decision
Accused to be detained in custody pending further trial.
Application
Mr.Kum:- Application is made by the police for books to
be confiscated which were seized from three other book-stores, Nos
518, 524 and 515, the managers were absent when the police visited,
so they have not been arrested. I ask that the books be kept at
the police station, pending the arrest of the managers, and also

被告对法官说：这些书籍并非由华通书局出版，也不是在本店印刷的。这些书籍销路很好，因此出于商业目的我们备有存货。政府并未禁止这些书籍。我们不想为共产主义政府效力。我否认这些书籍是由本店印刷的。
张先生：这些书籍并非在本店印刷，因此被告不应承担责任。另外两人，Foo Shing（音译）和Loh Ching（音译）尚未被捕，我请求法庭签发对他们的逮捕令。此外，我请求本庭审理此案。
被告代表郑先生（音译）：这些书籍并非在本店印刷，其他商店也销售这些书籍。被告仅持有这些书籍用于销售。我请求允许被告保释，因为他可以提供所有书籍出版商的地址。
金先生（音译）：在还押期间，被告可以提供出版商的名字，警方可以进行进一步调查。
裁决
被告将被拘留，等候进一步审讯。
申请
金先生（音译）：警方申请没收从另外三家书店（福州路518号、524号和515号）查获的书籍，警方走访时经理不在场，因此他们未被逮捕。我请求将这些书籍保存在警察局，以待逮捕经理，并请求法庭签发对他们的逮捕令。

purpose.

卡明副督察长。

Made by D.P.S. Mac Adie Forwarded by Henry Robertson Det. Insp.

With reference to the letter dated March 16, 1931 from
the Superintendent-in-Charge, Judicial Police, Shanghai Special
District Court forwarding an enquiry from Showin Wetsun Hsu,
President of the above court, on the subject of the occupants
of 165 Shantung Road, enquiries show that these premises are
occupied by the following four firms :-

Chun San (中山) Book Store
Manager : Chow Tien Sze (周天賜); deals in books
relating to the Three Principles of the People.

Nan Hwa (南華) Book Store
Manager : Chang Shing San (張森山); deals in primary
school text books.

Hwa Lien (華蓮) Company
Manager : Sung Sih-chun (沈世駿); manufacturer of
silver shields.

Kiang Nan (江南) Book Store
Manager : Te Foh Nyien (戴福年).

The rental of the said premises is $139 per mensem, and
is shared equally by the four businesses in question which operate
independent of each other.

These four firms use the same entrance, which is
situated on Shantung Road, there being no back door, and are
contained together in two rooms on the ground floor; therefore,
the sealing orders if they are to be effective must operate
against all these four businesses, thus making it impossible
to single out the Kiang Nan Bookstore and seal it alone.

R. W. Mac Adie.
D.C.(Br.& Sp.Branches) D. P. S.

KUOMINTANG TO INVESTIGATE SEALING OF BOOKSTORES

The Shun Pao, the Min Kuo Pao, and other local
newspapers publish the following report :-
The sealing of the Poh Sing, Lien Huh and other
bookstores, Shanghai, by the 2nd Branch of the Kiangsu
High Court is attracting the attention of the public.
Interviewed by a reporter yesterday, an important
officer of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang made
the following statement:-
Before the sealing of the bookstores, the Propaganda
Department of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang
did not know anything about it as the Central Kuomintang
Headquarters had not issued any orders to seal the book-
stores. The Kuomintang learned the matter from the news-
papers. Enquiries made at the Branch Court of the
Kiangsu High Court show that the sealing order was issued
upon receipt of a dispatch from the Headquarters of the
Garrison Commissioner of Woosung and Shanghai. How-
ever, the officers of the Military Headquarters stated
that cases relating to reactionary publications were
handled by the Detective Branch of the Military Headquarters
and that the sealing of the book stores was carried out
by the Detective Branch with the assistance of the
Settlement Police.
As the book stores which have been sealed, have
applied to the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang and
the Central Kuomintang Headquarters for the removal of
the seals, the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang is
now investigating the matter.

国民党调查书店查封事件

《申报》、《民国日报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
江苏高等法院第二分院查封上海博兴、联华等书店一事正引起公众关注。上海特区国民党一位重要官员昨日接受记者采访时发表如下声明：
在查封书店之前，上海特区国民党宣传部对此事一无所知，因为国民党中央总部并未发布任何查封书店的命令。国民党是从报纸上得知此事的。向江苏高等法院分院查询后显示，查封令是在收到吴淞上海卫戍司令总部的公函后签发的。然而，军事总部的官员表示，涉及反动出版物的案件由军事总部侦探科处理，查封书店是由侦探科在租界警方的协助下执行的。
由于被查封的书店已向上海特区国民党和国民党中央总部申请解除查封，上海特区国民党目前正在调查此事。

Translation of Despatch from the Shanghai Special District Court.

No. 5554. March 2, 1931.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

I am in receipt of a despatch from the Headquarters of the Woosung and Shanghai Garrison Commander to the following effect:-

"We have to state that Dung Ting Ting, Chief of our Detective Squad, reported that, with the assistance of the Shanghai Municipal Police, one Yui Ziang Sung (余祥森) (1), manager of Wo Thong Bookstore (華通) was arrested and 9 bundles of reactionary literatures were seized at the three bookstores, namely, Pok Sing (北新) (2), Loh Jung (樂群) (3) and Wo Thong (華通) (4), which were kept in your honourable court. Now, that the above mentioned three bookstores are selling communistic literatures is well proved. With reference to those bookstores, such as Kiang Nan (江南) (5), Kwaung Wo (光華) (6), Jung Tsong (群衆) (7) and Kwaung Ming (光明), it is reported that they are well known to be the publishers or the sale agents for communistic literatures, although they have concealed evidence of such for a short time."

"Therefore, apart from writing you for extradition of the criminal Yui Ziang Sung, we have to request that necessary steps be taken with a view to having the above mentioned seven bookstores, namely, Pok Sing, Loh Jung, Wo Thong, Kiang Nan, Kwaung Wo, Jung Tsong and Kwaung Ming, sealed, and the responsible persons therein prosecuted."

Made by D. S. I. Moore. Forwarded by

Sir,
With reference to the seizure of reactionary books from
the "Loh Kyuin" Bookstore, 518 Foochow Road; the "Poh Sing"
Bookstore, 524 Foochow Road, and the "Woo Tung" Bookstore,
529 Foochow Road, on January 19, 1931, on Search Warrants
issued by the Shanghai Special District Court at the instance
of the Soongwu Military Authorities, translations of the
worst items from the books seized have been made in compliance
with instructions and are submitted attached.

All of the articles in question are of a Communist and
reactionary nature, with the exception of one from the "Iron
Wheel", which is considered indecent.

Waung Sing Ming(王向民) and Li Ta Yoong(李太雲), the
proprietors of bookstores 518 and 524 Foochow Road, against
whom warrants of arrest were issued by the S. S. D. Court on
January 20, are reported to be in Nanking and Peking respectively.

The "Loh Kyuin" Bookstore, 518 Foochow Road, is at
present in charge of one Lee Suh Ming(李叔明), and the
"Poh Sing" Bookstore, 524 Foochow Road, in charge of Zee Yoong
Chung(徐榮慶), the latter person, according to the shop
assistants, left for Kangying near Changchow a few days ago
and is expected back in a weeks time.

As there seems no likelihood of the two wanted persons
being apprehended at present, instructions are asked as to
whether or not application should be made to the Court for
sealing orders to be issued against the premises in question.

D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

由 D. S. I. Moore 编制。呈送

先生，
关于1931年1月19日根据上海特区法院应淞沪军事当局请求签发的搜查令，从福州路518号“洛记”书店、福州路524号“博兴”书店以及福州路529号“华通”书店查获反动书籍一事，遵照指示，已对查获书籍中性质最为恶劣的内容进行了翻译，现随文附上。

除一篇出自《铁轮》的文章被视为淫秽内容外，所有相关文章均具有共产主义和反动性质。

福州路518号和524号书店的店主王向民 (Waung Sing Ming) 和李太雲 (Li Ta Yoong)，特区法院已于1月20日对他们签发逮捕令，据报两人分别位于南京和北京。

Translation of extracts from a book entitled "Scientific
Socialism", copies of which were seized on 19-1-51
at the Hwa Toong Bookstore, No. 529 Foochow Road.

(Pages 70, 71, 72, 73, and 74)

The manifesto of the Communist Party was
drafted in 1847 and issued in January of the following
year. At that time, it was impossible in any
country for the proletarian classes to participate in
politics and seize political authority by occupying
the majority of positions in parliament. This is
why Marx has said that violence is a necessary step.
It does not mean that Marx prefers violence before
peaceful measures. As the ruling classes have
not only refused the participation of the proletarian
classes in politics but are continuing to oppress them,
the proletarian classes cannot be resort to violence.
The ruling classes and the proletarian classes are
standing against each other. Whether the struggle
between the opposing classes is to be settled by
peaceful measures or by violence can be ascertained by
the attitude of the ruling classes. If the ruling
classes continue to oppress their opponents and dis-
regard all protests, the oppressed classes will not
wait quietly for their death and will resort to armed
violence. This is the only way.
A political revolution, irrespective of
its methods, is completed when the proletarian classes
have seized political authority. After the political
revolution, a social form of government will then
come into existence. In this new government the
political rulers are the proletarian classes. How
will the proletarian classes exercise their political
authority? In the manifesto issued by the
Communist Party, it is stated that the proletarian
classes are to use their authority to seize gradually
all the means of production of the Capitalistic
classes, and that when the means of production are in
the hands of the government, the development of
production will then be possible. Certain plans of
production will be introduced and all the people
throughout the country will become labourers. There
will be no capitalists and the social revolution is then
said to be complete.
In the manifesto issued by the Communist Party,
it is said that the nationalisation of means of
production is to be carried out gradually on the following
methods:-
1) Nationalization of land.
2) The enforcement of the Progressive Tax---A tax
collected in proportion to the amount of income.
3) The confiscation of the property of rebels and
emigrants.
4) The abolition of the inheritance system. All
inherited property is to go to the Government.
pages.zh:
译自题为《科学社会主义》一书的摘录，该书副本于1931年1月19日在福州路529号华通书店查获。

（第70、71、72、73和74页）

《共产党宣言》起草于1847年，并于次年一月发表。当时，在任何国家，无产阶级阶级都无法通过占据议会多数席位来参与政治并夺取政治权力。这就是为什么马克思说暴力是必要的一步。这并不意味着马克思在和平手段之前更倾向于暴力。由于统治阶级不仅拒绝无产阶级阶级参与政治，而且继续压迫他们，无产阶级阶级不得不诉诸暴力。统治阶级和无产阶级阶级处于对立状态。对立阶级之间的斗争是通过和平手段还是通过暴力来解决，取决于统治阶级的态度。如果统治阶级继续压迫其对手并无视所有抗议，被压迫阶级不会静静等待死亡，而将诉诸武装暴力。这是唯一的出路。
政治革命，无论其方法如何，当无产阶级阶级夺取政治权力时即告完成。政治革命之后，一种社会形式的政府随之产生。在这个新政府中，政治统治者是无产阶级阶级。无产阶级阶级将如何行使他们的政治权力？在《共产党宣言》中指出，无产阶级阶级要利用他们的权力逐步夺取资产阶级阶级的所有生产资料，当生产资料掌握在政府手中时，生产的发展才成为可能。将实施某些生产计划，全国所有人都将成为劳动者。将不再有资本家，此时社会革命即告完成。
在《共产党宣言》中指出，生产资料的国有化将通过以下方法逐步实施：
1) 土地国有化。
2) 实行累进税——按收入比例征收的税。
3) 没收叛乱者和移民的财产。
4) 废除继承制度。所有继承财产归政府所有。

pages.en:
Translation of Extracts from a Book Entitled
"World Economics and Economic Policy" written
by E. Varga and translated by Lee Mih Mong.
(Copies of this book were seized from the Hwa Tung
Book Store, No. 529 Foochow Road, on 19-1-31)

Page 88

The revolutionary movement of the labouring
masses is the only way to solve our problem.
Russia has overthrown her capitalism. If we
follow her example, the Chinese revolutionists
will be supported by the international proletarian
classes. The Chinese revolution is in progress,
and if it can avoid great mistakes, it will win a
final victory.

Page 400

One year has elapsed since the failure of the
Chinese revolution. Is China going to be a
Capitalistic country? Can the Chinese Capitalistic
classes solve the land problem?

During the past few years, the Chinese Capitalistic
classes formed their general principles of economy
and are transforming China into a Capitalistic
country with some result. But the land problem
has by no means been solved. The real productive
Capitalistic classes are weak, and the capitalistic
classes and the landlord classes have combined into
one class. The income of the capitalistic
classes is derived from the rent on their real estate
or on what they can extract indirectly from the
peasants. They are, therefore, opposing a
land revolution. Whilst the peasants, impoverished
by the development of capitalism, will naturally
reach the highest point of revolution.

Page 404

Although the Nanking Government has the
Central Political Power, its authority reaches only
a few provinces along the Yangtse valley. In
Fengtien, there is Chang Hsueh Liang who is supported
pages.zh:
译自 E. Varga 著、李米蒙 (Lee Mih Mong) 译的《世界经济与经济政策》一书摘录。
（该书副本于1931年1月19日从福州路529号华通书店查获）

第88页

劳动群众的革命运动是解决我们问题的唯一途径。
俄国推翻了其资本主义。如果我们效仿其榜样，中国革命者将获得国际无产阶级阶级的支持。中国革命正在进行中，如果能避免重大错误，它将取得最终胜利。

第400页

中国革命失败已过去一年。中国会成为资本主义国家吗？中国资产阶级阶级能解决土地问题吗？

在过去几年里，中国资产阶级阶级形成了其总体经济原则，并在一定程度上成功地将中国转变为资本主义国家。但土地问题远未解决。真正的生产性资产阶级阶级力量薄弱，资产阶级阶级和地主阶级已合并为一个阶级。资产阶级阶级的收入来源于其房地产租金或从农民身上间接榨取的收益。因此，他们反对土地革命。与此同时，因资本主义发展而贫困化的农民，自然会达到革命的最高点。

第404页

虽然南京政府拥有中央政治权力，但其权威仅 reach 长江流域的几个省份。在奉天，有受日本支持的张学良；

pages.en:
(2)

by Japan; in the North-West, there is Feng Yu Hsiang;
in the North, there is Yen Shih Shan; in the South
there is the Kwangsi Clique, who are supported
by Great Britain; in Szechuen there are small and
large militarists including the well known known
Wu Pei Fu who is influential.
pages.zh:
(2)

在西北，有冯玉祥；
在北方，有阎锡山；
在南方，有受英国支持的桂系；
在四川，有包括颇具影响力的知名人物吴佩孚在内的大小军阀。

pages.en:
Translation of extracts from a book entitled
"History of Western Revolutions", written by
"King Poo Er"and "Poo Li Koo Er" and translated
by Kao Foong, copies of which were seized on 19-1-31
at the Poh Sing Bookstore, No. 524 Foochow Road.

Page 169.

The peasants in China have not been able to win a
final victory owing to lack of alliance to assist them in
the movement for the overthrow of the social system
constructed on a foundation of oppression. Until recently,
there has come into existence the proletarian classes; this
has changed the conditions of the peasants who as well as
the proletariats should be instructed by the experience
of the peasant revolutionary movements in the East and the
West so that they will be able to avoid errors in present
and future struggles.

Peasants in Western Europe and Russia have become
one of the motive forces of revolutionary movements. The
In the French Revolution in 1789, the All-Europe Revolution
in 1848, and the Russian Revolution in 1905-1917, the
peasant problem was a fundamental problem. In Russia,
the peasants and the proletariats did not gain a victory
over their common enemies until they had united. They
formed a government of peasants and labourers. There were
no capitalists or landlords, and all land became the
property of the government.

As Engels and Marx have said, the union of peasants
and proletariats is necessary for victory. In Engels's
book on the Peasant Problems in France and Germany, it is
stated, "In the near future, the Socialistic Party, when
seizing political power, must go from the city to the village.
Efforts should be made to prevent the separation of the
proletarian classes from the peasant classes."
pages.zh:
译自题为《西方革命史》一书的摘录，该书由“King Poo Er”和“Poo Li Koo Er”著，高丰 (Kao Foong) 译，副本于1931年1月19日在福州路524号博兴书店查获。

第169页。

中国的农民未能取得最终胜利，是因为缺乏联盟来协助他们推翻建立在压迫基础上的社会制度的运动。直到最近，无产阶级阶级才出现；这改变了农民的状况，农民以及无产者都应从东西方农民革命运动的经验中吸取教训，以便能够在当前和未来的斗争中避免错误。

西欧和俄国的农民已成为革命运动的动力之一。在1789年的法国大革命、1848年的全欧洲革命以及1905-1917年的俄国革命中，农民问题都是一个根本问题。在俄国，农民和无产者直到联合起来才战胜了他们共同的敌人。他们建立了工农政府。没有资本家或地主，所有土地都成为政府的财产。

正如恩格斯和马克思所说，农民和无产者的联合对于胜利是必要的。在恩格斯关于法国和德国农民问题的书中指出：“在不久的将来，社会党在夺取政权时，必须从城市走向农村。应努力防止无产阶级阶级与农民阶级的分离。”

pages.en:
Translation of Extracts from a Communistic Magazine
copies of which were seized on 19-1-31 at bookstores
Nos. 518 and 524 Foochow Road.

DER MODERNE JUNGE, NO. 2

In Commemoration of the Great Revolutionary Leaders---
Lenin, Liebknecht, Luxemburg.

Page 1

January 21, 1924, is the day when Lenin---
the great leader of proletarian classes and oppressed
people----passed away.

On January 15, 1919, Liebknecht----the German
revolutionary leader and Director of the International
Proletarian Youths Movements----was cruelly murdered by
the German capitalistic classes and the Social Democrats.
Miss Rosa Luxemburg, a female fighter of the World
Proletarian classes, was murdered at the same time.

Page 2

On these days every year the proletarian
classes and the oppressed people throughout the world
commemorate the death of the three great leaders, close
their ranks, and study Leninism more diligently. They
will continue the uncompleted work of their late leaders.

Page 3

The attack upon Soviet Russia by the
Imperialists was accelerated in July of last year when
a controversy over the China Eastern Railway arose between
China and Russia. The amicable settlement of this
controversy was due to the peaceful policy of the Soviet
Government and the strong opposition raised by the
proletarian classes throughout the world. The
Imperialistic countries such as Japan, Great Britain,
the U.S.A. and France are now making war preparations.
Therefore, in this year's anniversary of the death of
our great leaders, our most important duty is to carry
out Lenin's will.
pages.zh:
译自共产主义杂志摘录，该杂志副本于1931年1月19日在福州路518号和524号书店查获。

《现代青年》，第2期

纪念伟大的革命领袖——列宁、李卜克内西、卢森堡。

第1页

1924年1月21日，是列宁——无产阶级阶级和被压迫人民的伟大领袖——逝世的日子。

1919年1月15日，德国革命领袖、国际无产阶级青年运动负责人李卜克内西，被德国资产阶级阶级和社会民主党人残酷杀害。世界无产阶级阶级的女战士罗莎·卢森堡小姐也在同一时间被杀害。

第2页

每年的这些日子，全世界的无产阶级阶级和被压迫人民纪念这三位伟大领袖的逝世，紧密团结，更加勤奋地研究列宁主义。他们将继续完成已故领袖未竟的事业。

第3页

去年七月，当中俄之间发生中东铁路争议时，帝国主义对苏维埃俄国的攻击加速了。这一争议的和平解决归功于苏维埃政府的和平政策以及全世界无产阶级阶级的强烈反对。日本、英国、美国和法国等帝国主义国家现在正在进行战争准备。因此，在今年纪念我们伟大领袖逝世的周年之际，我们最重要的职责是执行列宁的遗愿。

The great Chinese Revolution of 1925-7 failed
with immense loss because of the armed attack by
Imperialists and the sudden betrayal by the capitalistic
classes. The influence of the Imperialists in China
is growing and the Chinese people are suffering more
and more. Workers are paid reduced wages and given
more work, peasants are pressed into military service,
young soldiers are sent to the front to be killed by
poisonous gas, and students are ~~impr~~ imprisoned or murdered
by the ruling classes. Moreover, the capitalistic
classes are instigating the Trotzky Clique and the
Opposition Clique to mislead the youth by means of
reactionary propaganda. Therefore, in the great
anniversary of this year we must unite, raise the "banner
of Leninism", and accele/rate the high revolutionary wave.
EXTRACTS FROM POEMS
Pages 197 and 198
We never forget the day when the "Banner of Blood"
(? Red Flag) was hoisted over Canton.
Our blood and tears became a flood, and our bones
piled as high as a mountain.
This is our ever memorial day---a day when we shed our
blood.
Unless the sea and the ocean dry up and the high
mountain^s decay/s, we must settle the account even if our
skeletons are reduced to sand.
Why should we be afraid? The time has arrived.
The world is now divided into two camps. Load the gun
and draw the sword for this is the final and decisive
battle. Now is the time to settle old accounts.
We are not afraid and will not run away.
Go ahead and bathe in the blood. Swallow bullets
and shout. There is nothing which we cannot overthrow
even if it be Heaven.

1925-7年的中国大革命因帝国主义的武装攻击和资产阶级阶级的突然背叛而失败，损失惨重。帝国主义在中国的影响日益增长，中国人民遭受的苦难越来越深。工人工资降低，工作量增加，农民被强征入伍，年轻士兵被送往前线遭毒气杀害，学生被统治阶级监禁或谋杀。此外，资产阶级阶级正在煽动托洛茨基派和反对派，通过反动宣传误导青年。因此，在今年的重大周年纪念中，我们必须团结起来，高举“列宁主义旗帜”，加速高涨的革命浪潮。

第197和198页
我们永远不会忘记“血旗”（?红旗）在广州升起的那一天。
我们的血泪汇成洪流，我们的白骨堆积如山。
这是我们永远的纪念日——我们流血的日子。
除非海枯石烂，即使我们的骨架化为沙砾，我们也必须清算旧账。
我们何必害怕？时刻已经到了。
世界现在分为两个阵营。装上子弹，拔出利剑，因为这是最后的决战。现在是清算旧账的时候了。
我们不害怕，也不会逃跑。
前进，沐浴在鲜血中。吞下子弹并呐喊。没有什么是我们不能推翻的，即使是上天。

Translation of extracts from a book entitled
"Economy of the Transformation Period", written
by Bokharine & translated by Kiang Peh Yien,
copies of which were seized on 19-1-31 at No. 518
Foochow Road. (This book is published by the
Loh Hwa Book Store, Foochow Road)

Page 74

Revolutionary Marxism defines that the
period during which the political power is transferred
from the capitalistic class to the proletarian class As
the period when the old government collapses and
divides into separate organizations. Government
is not a gift which can be presented by one class
to another, nor is it a property which the capitalistic
class can hold by inheritance. The seizure of the
government by the proletarian class is to upset the
government system of the capitalistic class and to
establish a new government system. During this
transformation period, some of the factors of the
old system collapse and some are included in the new
system. This is the opinion of Marx and Engels,
but many students of Socialism have childish ideas
regarding the seizure of political power by the
proletarian class. They hold that the political power
can be seized in its original form by transforming
the government. This opinion seems to be correct
but it is really a mistake.

-----

Pages 78 & 79 From the above analysis we must
conclude that "industrial renascence" is impossible
if the factors of collapsing capitalism are used as
foundation. The only way is for the labouring classes
to assume dictatorship. Or, in other words, the
renascence of the community depends upon the
realisation of Communism.

In a word, to reform the system of
capitalism is impossible. Society can be developed if
we can form the industrial workers into a new organization.

第74页

革命马克思主义将政治权力从资产阶级转移到无产阶级期间的时期定义为：旧政府崩溃并分裂为各个独立组织的时期。政府不是可以由一个阶级赠送给另一个阶级的礼物，也不是资产阶级可以通过继承持有的财产。无产阶级夺取政府，就是要推翻资产阶级的政府制度，并建立一个新的政府制度。在这个过渡时期，旧制度的某些因素崩溃，某些因素被纳入新制度。这是马克思和恩格斯的观点，但许多社会主义研究者对于无产阶级夺取政治权力抱有幼稚的想法。他们认为，通过改造政府，就可以以原有形式夺取政治权力。这种观点看似正确，实则是错误的。

-----

第78及79页 从上述分析中我们必须得出结论：如果以正在崩溃的资本主义因素为基础，“工业复兴”是不可能的。唯一的出路是劳动阶级实行独裁。换言之，社会的复兴取决于共产主义的实现。

总之，改革资本主义制度是不可能的。如果我们能将产业工人组成一个新的组织，社会就能得到发展。

第86页 如果任何革命的无产阶级阶级在不久的将来或在无产阶级专政开始时无法说服这些农民加入他们，他们至少应说服农民保持中立，以便农民不会在斗争中协助资产阶级——列宁。

第94页 在俄国革命中，作为无产阶级阶级斗争盟友的贫农，未能遵守无产阶级的社会主义。目前大量农民也在做同样的事。然而，贫农仍然与无产阶级阶级合作，协助反对资本主义的斗争以及建立无产阶级政治权威。马克思、恩格斯和列宁曾指出，在即将到来的无产阶级革命中，小农将成为无产阶级阶级的盟友，尽管他们的目标可能并不相同。

第103页
产业工人在将资产阶级的资本（如材料、机器、工具等）转化为社会公有财产后，将获得解放。农民在从大农和封建首领手中夺取土地并将其变为社会公有财产后，将获得解放。这样，产业工人和小农将摆脱贫困。

The Indian Revolution.

Page 3. The flag of British Imperialism
is flying all over the world. The material foundation
of British Imperialism is constructed on the Indian
people. The victory of the Indian Revolution will
hasten the death of British Imperialism and the death
of British Imperialism will be the direct sign of the
death of International Imperialism. While we are
earnestly expecting the arrival of the Indian Revolution,
we must study the economic and other conditions in India.

Pages 4 and 5. Great Britain will never give
up India because it is so important geographically and
economically. In spite of the repeated entreaties of
the Indian capitalistic classes, the Imperialistic
British executioners have not granted independence
of India.
The capitalistic classes in India have
betrayed the revolutionary movements of the Indian
peasants and labourers, We know well how Gandhi
served in the Boer War. The resolution of the
Bardola Conference to comfort the Prince of Wales
after an attempted assassination is a disgrace as well
as proof of the treachery of the capitalistic classes
in India.
If the Indian revolution is directed by
labouring and peasant classes, we are sure that it will
achieve a victory as glorious as that of the October
Revolution in Russia.

印度革命。

第3页。英帝国主义的旗帜飘扬在世界各地。英帝国主义的物质基础建立在印度人民之上。印度革命的胜利将加速英帝国主义的灭亡，而英帝国主义的灭亡将是国际帝国主义灭亡的直接标志。在我们殷切期待印度革命到来之际，我们必须研究印度的经济和其他状况。

第4和第5页。英国绝不会放弃印度，因为印度在地理和经济上都非常重要。尽管印度资产阶级反复恳求，但帝国主义英国的刽子手们并未给予印度独立。
印度的资产阶级背叛了印度农民和劳工的革命运动。我们很清楚甘地在布尔战争中的表现。巴尔多拉会议（Bardola Conference）在威尔士亲王遇刺未遂后决定向其表示慰问，这既是一种耻辱，也是印度资产阶级叛徒行径的证明。
如果印度革命由劳工和农民阶级领导，我们相信它将取得如同俄国十月革命那样辉煌的胜利。

什么是政治经济学。
（斯捷潘诺夫（Stepanoff）撰写的讲座。
由罗义元（Loh Yih Yuan，音译）翻译）。

第64页。我们是列宁主义者，我们在理论和实践上都应该是列宁主义者。
真正的列宁主义要求我们的政治经济学应与马克思、恩格斯和列宁的政治经济学相同。我们的政治经济学必须指出无产阶级阶级解放的条件。

"The Battle Line of Social Science", copies of which
were seized on 19-1-31 from a bookstore at 518 Foochow Road.

Two Opposing Political Powers in Modern Countries

Page 3 Modern countries are capitalistic countries,
where the capitalistic classes are controlling and
oppressing the proletarian classes. For the oppression
of the proletian classes, there are troops, policemen,
military police, gaols, Courts, detectives, and strike
breakers.
Page 4. Policemen and gendarmes in capitalistic
countries are used especially for the oppression of the
proletarian classes. Their duty is to ensure the safety
of the capitalists and to break strikes or other labour
movements.
The laws of capitalistic nations protect
the rich and punish the poor. The judicial system
safeguards the private property of the capitalists.
Page 7 A socialistic country should carry out
the following:-
1) Overthrow the armed forces of the capitalistic
classes such as the standing army and organize a special
army of the labouring class.
2) Abolish the Police System because the Police
are used to protect the capitalists and to oppress the
proletarian classes who should have their own defence
force.
3) Abolish the judicial system of the capitalistic
class. Judges should be elected from amongst the
labourers and peasants who should have the right to remove
them.
Page 17 The Chinese Kuomintang represents the
political authority of the bullies and the capitalists
who are supported by the Imperialists. Chiang Kai Shek
at one time claimed to be a Mussolini because of his
White Terrorism and at another time he claimed to be a
MacDonald because he declared that the Three Principles
of the People are socialistic in character.
Following the betrayal by the capitalistic
classes, the Chinese proletarian classes have started to
establish Soviet political authority. Many Soviet areas
have come into existence within a short period. At the
recent national conference of Soviet area representatives,
the following laws were drafted:-
The political principles of the National Soviet Government.
Provisional Land Regulations.
Labour Protection Law.
Regulations governing the organization of Soviet Governments.
Page 18 Most of the people still believe
that the National Government---the political authority
of bullies, landlords, compradores, and other capitalists---
with its millions and millions of soldiers is the only
political authority in China. This is untrue. The
revolutionary movement is rapidly developing and its
victories can hardly be concealed. In the Soviet
areas in China, there is a population of more than
20,000,000. There are more than 5,000,000 armed peasants,
and more than 100,000 troops in the Regular Red Army.
Therefore, the armed forces of the Soviet areas are not
only strong enough to safeguard the Soviet Government but also
to overcome the whole country.

现代国家中两种对立的政治权力

第3页 现代国家是资本主义国家，资产阶级在那里控制和压迫无产阶级阶级。为了压迫无产阶级阶级，拥有军队、警察、宪兵、监狱、法院、侦探和罢工破坏者。
第4页。资本主义国家的警察和宪兵专门用于压迫无产阶级阶级。他们的职责是确保资本家的安全，并破坏罢工或其他劳工运动。
资本主义国家的法律保护富人，惩罚穷人。司法制度保护资本家的私有财产。
第7页 社会主义国家应执行以下措施：-
1) 推翻资产阶级的武装力量，如常备军，并组织一支特殊的劳动阶级军队。
2) 废除警察制度，因为警察被用来保护资本家并压迫无产阶级阶级，后者应该拥有自己的防御力量。
3) 废除资产阶级的司法制度。法官应从劳工和农民中选举产生，且劳工和农民应有权罢免他们。
第17页 中国国民党代表了受帝国主义者支持的恶霸和资本家的政治权威。蒋介石因其白色恐怖曾一度自称是墨索里尼，又因宣称三民主义具有社会主义性质而自称是麦克唐纳。
在资产阶级背叛之后，中国无产阶级阶级开始建立苏维埃政治权威。许多苏维埃区域在短时间内相继成立。在最近的苏维埃区域代表全国会议上，起草了以下法律：-
全国苏维埃政府的政治原则。
土地暂行条例。
劳动法。
苏维埃政府组织条例。
第18页 大多数人仍然相信，国民政府——即恶霸、地主、买办和其他资本家的政治权威——凭借其数以百万计的士兵，是中国唯一的政治权威。这是不真实的。革命运动正在迅速发展，其胜利几乎无法掩盖。在中国的苏维埃区域，人口超过2,000万。有超过500万武装农民，正规红军中有超过10万部队。因此，苏维埃区域的武装力量不仅足以保卫苏维埃政府，而且足以征服全国。

An Open Letter to the Whole Body of Representatives
of the General Meeting of Peasant Representatives.

Page 83

Our Party---a party of awakened labourers and
poor peasants---must seek another kind of democratic
republican government. We desire a Republican
Government with no policemen to insult the people; in
which all public officers, irrespective of their rank,
must be chosen by election and may be removed at the
request of the people; in which the pay of officers do
not exceed the pay of the most skillful workers; in which
all military officers are elected; and in which the
people's militia or other armed forces of the people take
the place of the Standing Army which is separated from,
and is antagonistic to, the people.

We desire a Republican government in which political
authority is absolutely and completely placed in the hands
of the Soviet of labour, peasant, and soldier representatives.

As labourers and peasants constitute a majority
of population, political authority should be placed in their
hands but not in the hands of the landlords, the
capitalists, or the officials.

第4页
资本主义国家设有以下机构以压迫工人：-
1) 军队。军事军官是贵族，以及地主和大资本家的儿子。
2) 法院。法院用于处置对资本家有危险的人。
3) 警察和宪兵。他们是工人的敌人，受雇来压迫工人。
4) 侦探和间谍。他们负责监视工人的动向。
除上述之外，还有教会、学校和出版商在智力上误导劳动阶级。事实上，资产阶级的教师、学者、记者和牧师正在毒害劳动阶级的智慧，教导他们在年轻时服从资本家。

第14页
为了建立共产主义社会，劳动阶级必须剥夺资产阶级的生产资料。由于资产阶级不会不进行抵抗就放弃其生产资料，并将利用政府的所有权力镇压工人，因此劳动阶级在为共产主义事业斗争的过程中，必须首先推翻资产阶级政府，并组织无产阶级阶级的政府。
劳动阶级在夺取政治权力后，必须建立无产阶级专政，以应对工厂主、地主和银行家等的抵抗。劳动阶级必须毫不

Science Textbook, Part 1, Book 2", copies of which
were seized from a bookstore at No. 518 Foochow Road,
on 19-1-31. (The books is published by the Tsung Tsieu
Book Store , Poo Yih Lee, Avenue Road).

Page 155.

Socialistic Theories and Proletarian Struggles

Where there is labour movement, there is
socialism, but socialism does not come from proletarian
classes. Both socialism and the labour movement
are the products of capitalism; they both oppose the
oppression of labouring classes by capitalism.

Labour movement---that is, resistance by
the proletarian classes against oppression by capitalism---
happens naturally at places where labourers are living.
Socialism, however, does not come into existence without
a thorough understanding of the nature of the present
social organisation. All Socialists hold that
poverty cannot be eradicated at the present time due
to the existence of the Bourgeoise Class, that poverty
is the result of private production; and that poverty
can be avoided if the system of owning property is
abolished. All kinds of socialism holds the same
view except about the method for the abolition of the
private property system and the method for the distribution
of property in the new society.

Page 157

Marx has said that only the labouring
classes can realise socialism. This means that
proletarian classes can secure emancipation through their
own efforts.

If Socialism is not supported by
extensive labour movements, it has no practical meaning
and is unworthy of our discussion; if labour movement
is not based upon the principles of Socialism, it cannot

第155页。

社会主义理论与无产阶级斗争

哪里有劳工运动，哪里就有社会主义，但社会主义并非源自无产阶级阶级。社会主义和劳工运动都是资本主义的产物；它们都反对资本主义对劳动阶级的压迫。

劳工运动——即无产阶级阶级对资本主义压迫的抵抗——自然发生在劳动者居住的地方。然而，如果不彻底了解当前社会组织的性质，社会主义就不会产生。所有社会主义者都认为，由于资产阶级阶级的存在，贫困目前无法根除，贫困是私有生产的结果；如果废除财产所有制，就可以避免贫困。各种社会主义流派观点相同，只是在废除私有财产制度的方法以及新社会中财产分配的方法上有所不同。

第157页

马克思曾说，只有劳动阶级才能实现社会主义。这意味着无产阶级阶级可以通过自身的努力获得解放。

如果社会主义没有得到广泛的劳工运动的支持，它就没有实际意义，也不值得我们讨论；如果劳工运动不基于社会主义原则，它就不能

socialism are not for pastime study but for enforcement
in proletarian struggles.
The most important duty of the proletarian
class is to organize all the labouring masses and
cause them to separate from the Bourgeoise class. This
work, however, cannot be done if the theories of
Socialism are not observed. Socialism tells us
how to separate the proletarian class from the
Bourgeoise class.

得到充分发展。确实，社会主义理论不是为了消遣学习，而是为了在无产阶级的斗争中执行。
无产阶级阶级最重要的职责是组织所有劳动群众，并使他们与资产阶级阶级分离。然而，如果不遵循社会主义理论，这项工作就无法完成。社会主义告诉我们如何将无产阶级阶级与资产阶级阶级分开。

DER MODERNE JUNGLE, NO. 2
In Commemoration of the Great Revolutionary Leaders---
Lenin, Liebknecht, Luxemburg.

Page 1

January 21, 1924, is the day when Lenin---
the great leader of proletarian classes and oppressed
people----passed away.

On January 15, 1919, Liebknecht----the German
revolutionary leader and Director of the International
Proletarian Youths Movements----was cruelly murdered by
the German capitalistic classes and the Social Democrats.
Miss Rosa Luxemburg, a female fighter of the World
Proletarian classes, was murdered at the same time.

Page 2

On these days every year the proletarian
classes and the oppressed people throughout the world
commemorate the death of the three great leaders, close
their ranks, and study Leninism more diligently. They
will continue the uncompleted work of their late leaders.

Page 3

The attack upon Soviet Russia by the
Imperialists was accelerated in July of last year when
a controversy over the China Eastern Railway arose between
China and Russia. The amicable settlement of this
controversy was due to the peaceful policy of the Soviet
Government and the strong opposition raised by the
proletarian classes throughout the world. The
Imperialistic countries such as Japan, Great Britain,
the U.S.A. and France are now making war preparations.
Therefore, in this year's anniversary of the death of
our great leaders, our most important duty is to carry
out Lenin's will.

《现代青年》，第2期
纪念伟大的革命领袖——
列宁、李卜克内西、卢森堡。

第1页

1924年1月21日是列宁——无产阶级阶级和被压迫人民的伟大领袖——逝世的日子。

1919年1月15日，李卜克内西——德国革命领袖和国际无产阶级青年运动主任——被德国资本家阶级和社会民主党人残酷谋杀。罗莎·卢森堡小姐，世界无产阶级阶级的女战士，也在同一时间被谋杀。

第2页

每年的这些日子，全世界的无产阶级阶级和被压迫人民纪念这三位伟大领袖的逝世，紧密团结，更加勤奋地研究列宁主义。他们将继续其已故领袖未完成的事业。

第3页

去年7月，当中俄之间因中东铁路发生争议时，帝国主义者对苏维埃俄国的攻击加速了。这一争议的和平解决归功于苏维埃政府的和平政策以及全世界无产阶级阶级提出的强烈反对。日本、英国、美国和法国等帝国主义国家现在正在进行战争准备。因此，在今年我们伟大领袖的逝世周年纪念日，我们最重要的职责是执行列宁的遗愿。

Pages 4 and 5

The great Chinese Revolution of 1925-7 failed
with immense loss because of the armed attack by
Imperialists and the sudden betrayal by the capitalistic
classes. The influence of the Imperialists in China
is growing and the Chinese people are suffering more
and more. Workers are paid reduced wages and given
more work, peasants are pressed into military service,
young soldiers are sent to the front to be killed by
poisonous gas, and students are imprisoned or murdered
by the ruling classes. Moreover, the capitalistic
classes are instigating the Trotsky Clique and the
Opposition Clique to mislead the youth by means of
reactionary propaganda. Therefore, in the great
anniversary of this year we must unite, raise the "banner
of Leninism", and accelerate the high revolutionary wave.

EXTRACTS FROM POEMS
Pages 197 and 198

We never forget the day when the "Banner of Blood"
(? Red Flag) was hoisted over Canton.
Our blood and tears became a flood, and our bones
piled as high as a mountain.
This is our ever memorial day---a day when we shed our
blood.
Unless the sea and the ocean dry up and the high
mountain decays, we must settle the account even if our
skeletons are reduced to sand.
Why should we be afraid? The time has arrived.
The world is now divided into two camps. Load the gun
and draw the sword for this is the final and decisive
battle. Now is the time to settle old accounts.
We are not afraid and will not run away.
Go ahead and bathe in the blood. Swallow bullets
and shout. There is nothing which we cannot overthrow
even if it be Heaven.

第4和第5页

1925-7年的中国大革命因帝国主义的武装攻击和资产阶级阶级的突然背叛而失败，损失惨重。帝国主义在中国的影响日益增长，中国人民遭受的苦难越来越多。工人工资降低，工作量增加，农民被强征入伍，年轻士兵被送往前线死于毒气，学生被统治阶级监禁或谋杀。此外，资产阶级阶级正在煽动托洛茨基派和反对派，通过反动宣传误导青年。因此，在今年的重大周年纪念日，我们必须团结起来，高举“列宁主义旗帜”，加速高涨的革命浪潮。

诗歌摘录
第197和198页

我们永远不会忘记“血旗”（？红旗）在广州升起的日子。
我们的血泪汇成洪流，我们的白骨堆积如山。
这是我们永远的纪念日——我们流血的日子。
除非沧海干涸，高山腐朽，否则即使我们的骨架化为沙砾，我们也必须算清这笔账。
我们何必害怕？时刻已经到了。
世界现在分为两个阵营。装上子弹，拔出宝剑，因为这是最后的决定性战斗。现在是算旧账的时候了。
我们不害怕，也不会逃跑。
前进，沐浴在鲜血中。吞下子弹并呐喊。没有什么是我们不能推翻的，即使是天。

February 19, 1931. 498

REPORT ON Assistance to Chinese Authorities in the execution of
Search Warrants on bookstores Nos. 518/524/and 529, Foochow Road.

Made by D.S.I. Moore. Forwarded by_

Sir,

With reference to the execution of Search Warrants on
the above mentioned bookstores on January 19, 1931, when 368
books containing alleged inflammatory matter were seized, and
one Yue Tsang Sun ( ), Proprietor of the "Woo Tung"
Bookstore, 529, Foochow Road, was arrested, I have to report that
Yue Tsang Sun who was remanded sine die at the S.S.D. Court
on January 20, 1931, on a charge of Offences Against Public
Order: Contrary to Article 160 of C.C.R.C., again appeared
before the Court on February 18, when the following judge-
ment was rendered:-"One year's imprisonment and 43 books
of an inflammatory nature confiscated. Two Day's detention
to count as one day's imprisonment."

At the first hearing on January 20, warrants of arrest
against were issued by the Court against Waung Sing Ming
(王心民), Proprietor "Loh Kyuin" Bookstore, 518, Foochow
Road, and Li Ts Yoong (李志雲), Proprietor "Poh Sing" Book-
store, 524, Foochow Road, but efforts to locate these persons
by this department and Louza Police Station detectives
have to date proved abortive, as both men are reported to
have left for Nanking on or about January 16, 1931.

Translations of the worst items from the books seized
will be available in a few days.

D.S.I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

S 5,
Please report again when the
translations are available.

关于协助中国当局执行对福州路518/524/及529号书店搜查令的报告。

由副督察长摩尔撰写。转呈_

先生，

关于1931年1月19日对上述书店执行搜查令一事，当时查获了368本据称含有煽动性内容的书籍，并逮捕了福州路529号“伍通”书店店主岳藏孙（Yue Tsang Sun）（ ），兹报告如下：岳藏孙于1931年1月20日以违反《中华民国刑法》第160条之妨害公共秩序罪在上海特区地方法院被无限期还押候审，并于2月18日再次出庭，法庭作出如下判决：“判处监禁一年，没收43本具有煽动性质的书籍。羁押两日折抵监禁一日。”

在1月20日的首次聆讯中，法院对福州路518号“洛群”书店店主王心民（Waung Sing Ming）和福州路524号“博星”书店店主李志云（Li Ts Yoong）发出了逮捕令，但本部门及老闸捕房侦探至今未能找到这些人，据报两人均已于1931年1月16日左右前往南京。

从查获书籍中选取的最恶劣内容的译文将在数日内提供。

副督察长
特务科主管。

S 5,
请在译文备妥后再次报告。

Extract of proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court for
Saturday, January 31st,1931.

Register No.5/21104. Stn No.2605 C. Louza Station.
Judge Mr.Chow.

Accused
Er Lai-soong ( ) Age re. Bookstore Assist.

Charge
Warrant No.1601 issued by the Shanghai Special District
Court at the instance of the Public Safety Bureau.
For that he, Er Lai Soong, did establish a Communistic
Organ and harbour one communist named Tsiang Ng Soong.
Compt :- Public Safety Bureau.

Proceedings
Mr.Paul Y Ru appeared for the Police.
Mr. Ru :- The Municipal Council are not charging the
accused. He was arrested on a warrant issued by this Court at the
request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau for having established
a communistic organ and harbouring a communist. The first warrant
the police received was for one named Tsiang Lai Sung of the Lee
Eur Book Store but this man could not be located. A second warrant
was issued for the man in charge of the book store, giving no name.
The police went to the book store and found the accused acting in
charge so he has been brought before the Court. The representative
of the Public Safety Bureau is not in Court. We do not know what
evidence they have against the accused or Tsiang.

A/C.D.S.93 :- At 3.50 p.m. yesterday D.S.I.Montgomery
came to Louza Police Station and requested assistance to execute
a warrant at a book store on Fochow Road. I was instructed to
arrest the man in charge of the store. I went there and they said
the man in charge was out, the accused then stated he was acting in
charge until the other man came back. I therefore arrested him and
took him to Louza Police Station. The accused stated he was
formerly employed in the Tan King Yung Book Store on Burkill Road
for one year and 7 months. We made enquiries and it was found
to be true.

Mr.Ru- This is the accused's statement.

Accused :- I am an assistant and Tsiang Ts Ming is in charge
of the book store. He was out yesterday so I was asked to take
charge until he returned. I do not know where he lives. I do not
know where he went. He left at 11.50 a.m. I was arrested after
3 p.m. I do not know Tsiang Lai Sung. Wong Sai Ling is the manager
of the store. We have nothing to do with the communists.

Judge :- I will remand this case for it to come before
Judge Hyui as the warrant was issued by him. The accused will put
up a $1,000.00 shop security.

Decision : Remand to Tuesday 3.2.31. A.M. for trial.
Accused to put up $1,000.00 shop security.

1931年1月31日（星期六）上海特区地方法院诉讼记录摘录。

登记号：5/21104。警局编号：2605 C。老闸捕房。
主审法官：周先生。

被告
Er Lai-soong（欧来松） 年龄约[原文不清]岁。职业：书店店员。

指控
由上海特区地方法院应公安局请求签发的第1601号逮捕令。
指控其，即 Er Lai Soong，建立共产主义组织并窝藏一名名为 Tsiang Ng Soong 的共产党员。
控方：公安局。

诉讼过程
Paul Y Ru 先生代表警方出庭。
Ru 先生：工部局并未对被告提出指控。他是根据本法院应上海公安局请求签发的逮捕令被捕的，罪名是建立共产主义组织并窝藏一名共产党员。警方收到的第一张逮捕令是针对李欧书店的 Tsiang Lai Sung，但此人未能找到。随后签发了第二张逮捕令，针对该书店负责人，未具名。警方前往书店，发现被告正在负责店务，因此将其带至法庭。公安局代表未出庭。我们不知道他们掌握有关被告或 Tsiang 的什么证据。

A/C.D.S.93：昨天下午3点50分，Montgomery 副督察来到老闸捕房，请求协助在福州路一家书店执行逮捕令。我奉命逮捕该店负责人。我到达那里时，他们说负责人外出了，被告随即表示在另一人回来之前由他代理负责。因此我逮捕了他，并将其带回老闸捕房。被告称他此前曾在伯基尔路（Burkill Road）的 Tan King Yung 书店受雇一年零七个月。经查询，情况属实。

Ru 先生：这是被告的陈述。

被告：我是一名店员，Tsang Ts Ming 负责书店管理。他昨天外出了，所以我被要求在他回来之前代为负责。我不知道他住在哪里。我不知道他去了哪里。他是上午11点50分离开的。我是在下午3点后被捕的。我不认识 Tsiang Lai Sung。Wong Sai Ling 是书店经理。我们与共产党没有任何关系。

法官：我将把此案延期审理，以便由 Hyui 法官审理，因为逮捕令是由他签发的。被告需缴纳1,000.00美元的店铺保释金。

裁决：延期至1931年2月3日（星期二）上午开庭审理。
被告需缴纳1,000.00美元店铺保释金。

My name is Mr Lai-soeng (歐來裳), aged 33, native
of Hunan.    I was married but I do not know where my
wife has gone now.    I was born at Yang Wu Tse (永和市),
Lieuyang Hsien (瀏陽縣) in the Hunan Province.    I lived
with my parents at my native place until I was 30 years
of age.    Between the ages of 12 and 16 I attended the
village school.    At the age of 16 years I was apprenticed
to the Yang Tsoong Tse (楊忠慈) Wine Shop at my native
village.    I remained there until I was 20 years of age
at which time I went to work with my father whose
name is Mr Sui Lieu (歐瑞廬).    At that time he
kept a wine shop called the Sa Wen Tsang (多文堂) at
our village.    I worked with him as shop assistant
until I was about 30 years of age.    About December 1928
I left my native village on account of communist
disorders, leaving my father there.    I came to Shanghai
with one Lieu Pei-Ling (劉偉林), a country man of mine.
I cannot say where this man has gone to now.    I under-
stand, however, that prior to my coming to Shanghai he was
in business at Nantao.    When I arrived at Shanghai,
I joined my uncle Mr Sung-toe (歐都), who was then
employed at the Tah Ping Yang (太平洋) Printing Company
16 Pai Ho Road.    I found employment at this place
and worked there until about July last year, when I
obtained a position as a shop assistant at the "Four
Combined Bookstore" through Tsang Tseh Ming (張哲民),
a countryman of mine, who had charge of the Sales Department
