我叫 Lai-soeng 先生（歐來裳），33岁，湖南籍。我已婚，但我不知道我妻子现在去了哪里。我出生于湖南省浏阳县永和市（Yang Wu Tse）。我在家乡与父母同住，直到30岁。12岁至16岁期间，我在村塾读书。16岁时，我在家乡村里的杨忠慈（Yang Tsoong Tse）酒铺当学徒。我一直在那里待到20岁，当时我去为我父亲工作，他名叫 Sui Lieu 先生（歐瑞廬）。那时他在我们村里经营一家名为多文堂（Sa Wen Tsang）的酒铺。我作为店员为他工作，直到大约30岁。1928年12月左右，因共产党骚乱，我离开家乡，留下父亲在那里。我与同乡刘伟林（Lieu Pei-Ling）一起来到上海。我说不出这个人现在去了哪里。不过，据我所知，在我来上海之前，他在南市经商。当我到达上海时，我投奔了我的叔叔 Sung-toe 先生（歐都），他当时受雇于白鹤路16号的太平洋（Tah Ping Yang）印刷公司。我在那里找到了工作，一直工作到去年7月左右，当时通过我的同乡、负责该书局销售部的张哲民（Tsang Tseh Ming），我在“四书局联合店”获得了一份店员职位

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 4, 1931

TRACKING DOWN REDS
IN SHANGHAI
Objection Made To The
Methods Of Chinese
Authorities

Condemnation of Chinese auth-
orities allegedly using the
Municipal police to arrest an in-
nocent person on a nameless war-
rant in order to extract from pri-
soner information of the where-
abouts of a suspected communist,
was voiced by Mr. Paul Y. Ru,
Assistant Municipal Advocate, in
the Shanghai Special District
Court yesterday.

Mr. Ru declared that this prac-
tice was contrary to Chinese
criminal procedure and was flag-
rantly borne out in the case at
bar, which was a prosecution
against an assistant of the Lee Eur
Bookstore, Foochow Road. The
accused was released on substan-
tial shop security to appear before
the court when required, on charges
of establishing a communist organ
in the bookstore and harbouring a
communist.

Mr. Ru, pointed out that the
charges were brought by extra-
Settlement authorities and not the
Settlement police. Accused, he
said, was arrested on a warrant
issued by the court at the request
of the Bureau of Public Safety.
Another warrant was originally
issued for a Chinese in charge of
the bookstore, who could not be
located, and who accused was
alleged to have sheltered.

In reply to the court, Mr. Ru
explained that prisoner was not
arrested on a warrant issued in
his name, but for any person in
charge of the store. When the
police descended on the place they
found prisoner in charge and ar-
rested him. Mr. Ru informed the
court that a representative of the
Bureau had not attended court,
and consequently the Municipal
police were at a loss to know what
evidence the Bureau would bring
against accused or any other
person connected with the store.

A Chinese detective sergeant
told the court that on the after-
noon of Friday last he was
instructed to go and arrest the
person in charge of the bookstore.
On arrival there he was told that
the man was away. Accused then
stated that he was temporarily
in charge until the man's return,
and he was thereupon arrested and
taken to the Louza station. Wit-
ness said accused told the police
that he was formerly employed in
another bookstore on Burkill Road.
This the police ascertained to be
true.

Accused declared that he did
not know the address of the man
in charge of the store, or his
present whereabouts. After giving
the name of the manager of the
store as Wong Sai-ming, prisoner
asserted that the store was not
engaged in any communist activi-
ties.

Asked by the judge whether he
was able to furnish $1,000 secur-
ity, prisoner replied that he was
not, explaining that he was only
a store assistant, and was acting
as a substitute for a person in
charge of its sales department
when he was arrested.

《字林西报》，1931年2月4日，星期三

在上海追踪赤色分子
对中国当局
做法提出异议

助理市政检察官 Paul Y. Ru 先生昨日在上海特区地方法院表示，谴责中国当局涉嫌利用工部局警察，凭一张无名逮捕令逮捕无辜者，以从囚犯口中套取疑似共产党员下落的信息。

Ru 先生宣称，这种做法违背了中国刑事诉讼程序，而在本案——即起诉福州路李欧书店一名店员的案件中——这一做法得到了公然印证。被告被控在书店内建立共产主义组织并窝藏一名共产党员，后经缴纳高额店铺保释金获释，条件是随传随到。

Ru 先生指出，指控是由租界外当局提出的，而非租界警察。他说，被告是根据法院应公安局请求签发的逮捕令被捕的。最初签发的另一张逮捕令是针对一名无法找到的书店中方负责人，据称被告窝藏了此人。

在回答法庭询问时，Ru 先生解释说，囚犯并非因以其名义签发的逮捕令被捕，而是因作为店内任何负责人被捕。当警察突袭该地时，发现囚犯正在负责店务，遂将其逮捕。Ru 先生告知法庭，公安局代表未出庭，因此工部局警察无从知晓公安局将对被告或与书店有关的任何其他人员提出何种证据。

一名华籍侦探警长告诉法庭，上周五下午，他奉命前去逮捕书店负责人。到达那里时，他被告知那人外出了。被告随即表示，在那人回来之前由他临时负责，于是他随即被捕并被带往老闸捕房。证人称，被告告诉警察他此前曾在伯基尔路的另一家书店受雇。警方经查证属实。

被告声称不知道书店负责人的地址或其当前下落。在说出书店经理名为 Wong Sai-ming 后，囚犯坚称该店未参与任何共产主义活动。

法官问他能否提供1,000美元保释金，囚犯回答说不能，并解释说他只是一名店员，被捕时正代替销售部负责人工作。

上海工部局警务处
C. B. 登记。
D. 1931.
2 - 31.

S.S. TAIYO MARU
日本邮船会社

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Assistance to Chinese Authorities. Arrest Form.
Name Er Lai Zoong (欧来崇), age 32, Hunan, residing Pei Ho Rd.
Arrested by A/C.D.S.93.
arrest took place. 30-1-31. Foochow Road.
At 3.15 p.m.30-1-31, D.S.I.Montgomery, attached to Special Branch, came to the Station and asked for assistance to serve two Shanghai Special District Court warrants, Nos.1600 and 1601, which were issued at the instance of the Public Safety Bureau, for the arrests of Tsiang Na Soong (蒋纳松), c/o Tsu Lung Kwang (朱隆光) Sales Department of 'Four Combined Book Store', 518 Foochow Road, and the person in charge of the 'Four Combined Book Store' respectively.
The warrants authorized the arrest of Tsiang Na Soong who is wanted on the charge of being one of the 'Provincial Communist Committee' and whoever was in charge of the above mentioned book store, for establishing a communist organ and harbouring one named Tsiang Na Soong
The necessary assistance was rendered by A/C.D.S.93 and the arrest of the acting Manager of the Sales Department of the 'Four Combined Book Store' name Eu Lai Zoong, effected. He came to Shanghai two years ago from Hunan and during that time he was employed with the Pacific Book Store, No.16 Pei Ho Road for one year and seven months, the remaining five months stay in Shanghai, he was employed with the 'Four Combined Book Store'
The above facts were verified by D.S.I.Turner and C.D.C.106.
The accused is charged as per warrant and will appear before the Court on the 31-1-31.
The accused denies knowledge as to the whereabouts of Tsiang Na Soong.
A statement was taken from the accused by D.S.I. Montogomery.
D.S.I.Turner and A/C.D.S.93 and C.D.C.106.

姓名 Er Lai Zoong（欧来崇），年龄32岁，湖南人，居住于北河路。
由代理副巡官93号（A/C.D.S.93）逮捕。
逮捕发生时间：1931年1月30日。福州路。
1931年1月30日下午3时15分，隶属特科的警司蒙哥马利（D.S.I. Montgomery）来到警局，请求协助执行两张上海特区地方法院签发的传票，编号分别为1600和1601，系应公安局之请签发，用于逮捕蒋纳松（Tsiang Na Soong），其通讯处为福州路518号“四合书局”销售部朱隆光（Tsu Lung Kwang），以及“四合书局”负责人。
传票授权逮捕被指控为“省委共产党委员会”成员之一的蒋纳松，以及上述书店的任何负责人，罪名是建立共产党机关并窝藏名为蒋纳松之人。
代理副巡官93号提供了必要协助，并成功逮捕了“四合书局”销售部代经理欧来宗（Eu Lai Zoong）。他两年前从湖南来到上海，在此期间，他在北河路16号太平洋书局受雇一年零七个月，在沪剩余的五个月里，他受雇于“四合书局”。
上述事实经警司特纳（D.S.I. Turner）和华探长106号（C.D.C.106）核实。
被告按传票被控，将于1931年1月31日出庭。
被告否认知晓蒋纳松的下落。
警司蒙哥马利对被告进行了问话并记录供词。
警司特纳、代理副巡官93号及华探长106号。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Mr Lai-zoong (欧来宗).
native of Hunan taken by me L. J. Montague
at Louza tne on the 30/1/31 and interpreted by Clerk Soo Yon-seng.

My name is Lai-zoong (欧来宗). I am
a native of Hunan, 34 years of age, and single. I
am residing in the 1st house of the last alley-way of
the Yue Chang Li, Wei Ho Road, off Burkill Road. I
am employed at the Four Combine Book Store (四合书局),
518 Nanking Road. The owners of the four shops are
Tang Tsoh-min (唐佐民), Oo Ung-tsau (吴振周),
Tchang Tang-woo (张汤武) and Chien Tsu-to (钱祖道).
I do not know the addresses of these persons. The
regular sales manager is Tchang Tsoh-min (张佐民).
As he has not come to his store for an indefinite period,
where I do not know, I am temporarily in charge of the
sales department of the Four Combine Book Store.
I was told that Chiang Hsi-boon (蒋希本) was an
employee of this shop, but I do not know further about him.
(s/d) r lai-zoong.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7
Special Branch No.3. Station,
REPORT
Date January 20 , 1930.
Subject (in full) Assistance to the Chinese Authorities in the execution of
Search Warrants on bookstores in the International Settlement.
Made by D.S.I.Moore. Forwarded by
Sir,
I have to report.with reference to the above mentioned
subject, that between 2.30 p.m. and 6.30 p.m.,January 19,I93I,
seven Search Warrants issued at the request of the Soongwu
Military Authorities by the S.S.D.Court to search and seize
certain reactionary books were executed by the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Police accompanied by representatives of the Soongwu
Authorities with the following results:-
"Loh Kyuin" Bookstore,518,Foochow Road. Seized:-a number
of books of a reactionary nature.
"Poh Sing" Bookstore,524,Foochow Road. Seized:- a number
of books of a reactionary nature.
"Woo Tung" Bookstore,529,Foochow Road. Seized:- a number
of books of a reactionary nature. The manager of the store
Yue Tsang Sun,who was on the premises at the time,was arrested.
An attempt to execute the remaining four warrants proved
abortive,as nothing of an incriminating nature could be found
on the premises.
The total number of books seized was 368 copies,a detailed
list of which is in the course of preparation.
The arrested person,Yue Tsang Sun,will be brought before
the S.S.D.Court on January 20,I93I, on a charge of Offences
against Public Order.Contrary to Art.160 of C.C.R.C.,when the
Chinese Authorities will apply for all books seized to be
confiscated.
D.S.I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
21/1/31

特别科第3巡捕房，
报告
日期：1930年1月20日。
事由（全称）：协助中国当局在国际租界内书店执行搜查令。
呈报人：D.S.I. Moore。转呈

先生，

兹就上述事由报告如下：1931年1月19日下午2时30分至6时30分之间，应淞沪军事当局请求，由特区地方法院签发了七张搜查令，用于搜查并扣押某些反动书籍。上海公共租界工部局警务处在淞沪当局代表的陪同下执行了这些搜查令，结果如下：

“洛魁因”书店（Loh Kyuin Bookstore），福州路518号。查获：若干本具有反动性质的书籍。

“博兴”书店（Poh Sing Bookstore），福州路524号。查获：若干本具有反动性质的书籍。

“吴同”书店（Woo Tung Bookstore），福州路529号。查获：若干本具有反动性质的书籍。该店经理岳藏孙（Yue Tsang Sun，音译）当时在场，已被逮捕。

其余四张搜查令的执行未果，因为在相关场所未发现任何具有罪证性质的物品。

查获书籍总数为368册，详细清单正在编制中。

被捕人员岳藏孙（Yue Tsang Sun，音译）将于1931年1月20日以违反《中华民国刑法》第160条之妨害秩序罪被提解至特区地方法院受审，届时中国当局将申请没收所有查获的书籍。

特别科督察长
特别科主任警官
1931年1月21日
